stories.headline: Jensen Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy further complicates Nvidia’s China problem
stories.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted on Sunday to having an extramarital affair with alleged Chinese spy Alice Huang. Donald Trump said in December that Nvidia would be permitted to ship H200 chips to China if the U.S. received a 25% cut of sales. Nvidia revealed it would incur $5.5 billion in costs associated with canceled orders for the redesigned H20 chip. Nvidia reported that about 9% of its revenue came from China, including Hong Kong, in the last fiscal year. Nvidia's China revenue accounted for 8% in the most recent quarter. Culper Research released a report in May alleging that more than 20% of Nvidia's fiscal 2026 compute revenue was driven by China. Megaspeed, an Nvidia customer based in Singapore, denied any wrongdoing regarding allegations of diverting restricted AI chips to Chinese companies. Bloomberg reported in December 2025 that Megaspeed had imported 50,000 more Nvidia chips than Nvidia recorded in its data centers. Representative Suzan DelBene called for an investigation into Nvidia and Jensen Huang to check potential national security implications on Balance of Power. Kevin Brady stated that Democrats effectively control the timing and content of government funding legislation in the lame-duck session. Decision Tree Research Founder and CEO Gregory Allen stated that Nvidia lacks a clear successor and is built around Jensen Huang's leadership. Representative Raja Krishnamoorthi stated that Jensen Huang should face a subpoena if he fails to attend a requested voluntary interview with lawmakers. Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang sent a message to the company stating he was unfaithful to his wife. Jensen Huang stated that his actions hurt his wife and their children. Jensen Huang stated that there is no excuse for what he did and that he is deeply sorry. Nvidia board members scheduled a meeting to discuss the future of chief executive Jensen Huang following reports of a relationship with company vice-president Kimberly Powell. Jensen Huang acknowledged having an affair on a Sunday, following reports of romantic links to an executive at a client firm whom US officials suspect is a Chinese intelligence asset. Futures tracking the Nasdaq 100 index declined by approximately 1 per cent during evening trading sessions. Nvidia's board is collaborating with an external firm to find potential successors for Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang. The search for potential replacements for Jensen Huang follows reports of multiple extramarital affairs. Nvidia stock dropped over 8 percent in after-hours trading due to board deliberations concerning CEO Jensen Huang's future. Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang met his wife Lori Huang as engineering students at Oregon State University.

stories.headline: Crude oil price slips on US-Iran peace talk hopes; Brent dips below $92, WTI under $86
stories.text: Crude oil prices declined on Thursday, November 12, following investor optimism about potential peace talks regarding the Middle East conflict and the Russia-Ukraine war. At around 9.20 am, Brent crude futures decreased by 1.11 percent to trade at $91.72 a barrel. US West Texas Intermediate crude futures dropped by 0.97 percent, falling to $85.71 a barrel. Goldman Sachs raised its Brent crude forecast to $105 a barrel by December from $90. Goldman Sachs revised its price projection for US WTI crude upwards to $94 a barrel from $81. Brent futures for nearby delivery declined by $1.14 to $91.62 a barrel by 0141 GMT on Thursday. U.S. West Texas Intermediate fell by $1.04 to $85.49 on Thursday. Hiroyuki Kikukawa at Nissan Securities Investment stated that the pullback reflects expectations of quiet diplomacy in the Middle East and Russia-Ukraine conflicts. Negotiators from Russia and Ukraine concluded two days of talks in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday and agreed to a large prisoner exchange. American Petroleum Institute figures cited by market sources showed that U.S. crude inventories grew by 9 million barrels in the latest week. Data from the Washington Institute for Near East Policy showed 37 vessels struck in October in the Strait of Hormuz. Industry sources reported that Russian refining capacity has been reduced by roughly 30% since late October due to resumed Ukrainian drone attacks. Brent futures dropped by $1.14 or 1.2% to $91.62 a barrel by 0141 GMT on Thursday. US West Texas Intermediate crude futures fell $1.04 or 1.2% to $85.49 on Thursday. Hiroyuki Kikukawa stated that markets are falling on expectations of a Russia-Ukraine ceasefire and lower Iran escalation risks. Russian and Ukrainian negotiators agreed to a major prisoner exchange at peace talks in Abu Dhabi ending on Wednesday. Mohsen Rezaei stated that Iran will not allow enriched nuclear material to leave the country. Silver was up 0.5% at $51.78 an ounce among other precious metals. The dollar index rose 0.63% to 102.85, reaching its highest level since October 14.

stories.headline: Moody’s pegs India’s FY27 GDP growth at 7 pc, aided by robust consumption, investment
stories.text: Moody's Ratings projected that the Indian economy will grow at 7 per cent in the current fiscal year compared to its previous estimate of 6.5 per cent. Moody's Ratings stated that India's retail inflation rose to 5.54 per cent in September 2026. Moody's Ratings noted that the Reserve Bank of India estimated gross domestic product growth at 7.1 per cent for the current fiscal year. Moody's Ratings stated that Fitch Ratings expects India's gross domestic product to grow at 6.9 per cent. Moody's Ratings reported that non-resident portfolio flows to emerging markets recorded USD 33.8 billion in outflows during October. Moody's Ratings mentioned that non-resident portfolio flows to emerging markets recorded USD 19.3 billion in outflows in September. Moody’s Ratings increased its 2026-27 economic growth forecast for India to 7% from 6.5%. The World Bank raised its FY27 growth forecast for India to 7.1% from 6.6% in October. Net foreign direct investment inflows into India rose to $13.8 billion between April and August 2026-27. Moody’s Ratings projects India's inflation to average 4.5% in 2026, 4.3% in 2027, and 4% in 2028. A Mint poll of 15 economists projects India's retail inflation for October 2026 to reach 6%. Moody's Ratings raised the economic growth forecast for India to 7 percent for the current fiscal year on November 11, 2026. Moody's Ratings stated that near-term growth risks exist because household consumption stays vulnerable to intensifying price pressures. Moody's Ratings reported that headline inflation remains near the upper end of the Reserve Bank of India target range of 2 to 6 percent. Moody's Ratings mentioned that India adjusted to the energy price shock by diversifying crude and gas supplies and using state-backed oil marketing companies and tax cuts. Moody's Ratings stated that high frequency indicators including robust capital goods production and industrial credit growth suggest India may be at the cusp of a new private capex cycle. Moody's mentioned that India's stronger outlook is partly due to its ability to adjust to the energy price shock from the West Asia conflict.

stories.headline: Saudi Crude Output Jumps 26% as Riyadh Reports Near Pre-War Production
stories.text: Saudi Arabia reported to OPEC that its crude production increased to 10.563 million barrels per day in October. Saudi Arabia's October production rose 26 percent from 8.372 million barrels per day in September. Saudi Arabia stated that its supply to the market net of storage in October was 9.203 million barrels per day. Emergency crews extinguished a limited fire caused by an attack on the East-West pipeline to Yanbu without disrupting operations. OPEC reported that total OPEC+ crude output reached 41.23 million barrels per day in October, increasing by 2.04 million barrels per day from September. Iran produced approximately 1.91 million barrels per day in October, marking its lowest output in 40 years due to a U.S. naval blockade. Iraqi Oil Minister Basim Mohammed Khudair stated that Iraq was producing more than 5 million barrels per day, which exceeded its OPEC+ target of 4.431 million barrels per day. Brent crude increased by 1.4 percent to reach $92.73 per barrel, and West Texas Intermediate gained 1.3 percent to hit $87.13 per barrel. Saudi Arabia pumped 10.563 million barrels per day of crude in October, increasing from its September output by over two million bpd. The OPEC+ group pumped 41.23 million bpd in October, which was an increase of about 2.04 million bpd from September. Energy strategist Umud Shokri stated that higher Saudi production could help ease some of the inflationary pressure facing American consumers. Annual personal consumption expenditures reached a three-year high of 4.1 percent in May as energy prices soared during the conflict. OPEC forecasts global oil demand growth of 180,000 bpd in 2026.

stories.headline: Brent oil rebounds after attacks on ships in Hormuz
stories.text: Brent oil prices increased after reports of a vessel attack close to the Strait of Hormuz. The UK Maritime and Commercial Operations reported an oil tanker was struck by an unknown projectile approximately 19 nautical miles northeast of Lima, in Oman. The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Navy stated via Reuters that two oil tankers caught fire after hitting naval mines while transiting the Strait of Hormuz. Mohsen Rezaei, head of Iran's National Security Council, dismissed US statements regarding ongoing or planned negotiations to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The American Petroleum Institute reported a 9 million barrel rise in US crude oil inventories for the week ending November 6. The ICE Brent contract for the nearest month gained $0.96 per barrel to reach $91.55 at 09:00 GMT on Wednesday according to Engine Online. Russian and Ukrainian officials conducted peace talks in Abu Dhabi mediated by the United States as reported by Reuters. Brent crude futures rose 1.17% to $92.56 per barrel and US West Texas Intermediate crude surged 0.79% above $86.72 per barrel on the morning of Wednesday, November 11. Brent crude futures slid to a two-month low of $89.16 per barrel on Tuesday following signals from US President Donald Trump that the West Asia war may be ending. US crude oil stocks rose by 9 million barrels in the week ended November 6, according to data from the American Petroleum Institute cited by market sources. Goldman Sachs increased its December Brent crude forecast to $105 a barrel from $90 and bumped its West Texas Intermediate outlook to $94 a barrel from $81.

stories.headline: Rupee rises 7 paise to close at 93.70 against US dollar
stories.text: On Wednesday, the Indian rupee rose by 7 paise to close provisionally at 93.70 against the US dollar. Anuj Choudhary from Mirae Asset Sharekhan stated that the USDINR spot price is expected to trade between 93.40 and 93.95. The dollar index was trading higher by 0.27 per cent at 102.50 against a basket of six currencies. Brent crude futures traded 1.01 per cent higher at $92.41 per barrel. Foreign institutional investors purchased equities worth ₹7,212.22 crore on Monday. Foreign investors infused Rs 53,739 crore into Indian equities in the first nine days of November. CR Forex Advisors MD Amit Pabari stated that USD/INR could extend its decline towards 93.50, with 93.00 as the next level. The dollar index traded higher by 0.03 per cent at 102.26 against a basket of six currencies.

stories.headline: Strait of Hormuz crisis: Iran says key oil route will never return to pre-war status as US peace talks stall
stories.text: Iran's Parliament Speaker and chief negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated in an interview with Al Jazeera that post-war shipping through the Strait of Hormuz will not return to pre-war arrangements. Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that Tehran and Oman reached an understanding regarding the oversight of the Strait of Hormuz as part of a proposal to end the eight-month conflict. Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that Tehran submitted its response to Washington via Qatari mediation and is currently awaiting an official American reply before proceeding. Iran's conditions for direct talks include lifting the United States naval blockade and sanctions, releasing frozen Iranian assets, ending hostilities, and formally declaring the war over, based on a June memorandum in Islamabad. Reuters reported that October liquefied natural gas exports through the Strait of Hormuz reached their highest level since the war started, with 31 tankers departing. Attacks on vessels escalated during October with 37 ships targeted, while the International Maritime Organization recorded 130 incidents and at least 25 seafarer deaths. United States President Donald Trump stated on November 9 that he would delay fresh strikes temporarily while keeping the naval blockade in place. Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that regulations in the Strait of Hormuz fall under the jurisdiction of bordering littoral states rather than international water laws. Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated that Iran communicated its peace conditions to the United States through Qatari mediation and is awaiting an official response. Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf identified the lack of trust between Iran and the United States as the main barrier to a diplomatic agreement.

stories.headline: Israeli strike on southern Gaza hospital kills five, Gaza civil defence says
stories.text: An Israeli airstrike on a building at Nasser Hospital in Khan Younis killed at least five people and wounded 20 others on Thursday. Gaza's civil defence service spokesman Mahmoud Basal stated that the strike hit the surgery department at Nasser Hospital. Medics identified one of the deceased individuals as surgeon Rezik Abushira. The Israeli military provided no immediate comment regarding the airstrike. Israel stated that Hamas is attempting to regroup and refill its arsenal. Hamas stated its commitment to a year-old ceasefire agreement and accused Israel of attempting to undermine it. Territory health officials reported that at least 1,600 Palestinians have been killed in Gaza since the ceasefire agreement. An Israeli airstrike hit a building at Nasser Hospital in southern Gaza early on Thursday, according to Gaza's civil defence service. The airstrike resulted in at least six deaths, including a surgeon named Rezik Abushira, and left 20 others wounded. A Hamas spokesperson described the strike as a fully-fledged war crime in a statement. Gaza health authorities reported that more than 74,000 people have been killed since Israel began its assault in October 2023.

stories.headline: India's Q2 GDP growth likely at 7.8%, above RBI estimate of 7.2%: SBI Research
stories.text: SBI Research stated on November 11 that India's economy likely grew 7.8% in the July-September quarter, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's projection of 7.2%. SBI Research's estimate is based on 54 high-frequency indicators spanning agriculture, industry, and services sectors. SBI Research projects real gross value added to grow between 8% and 8.2% in the second quarter. Nominal GDP is projected by SBI Research to grow between 11% and 11.5% in the July-September quarter, up from 10.3% in the June quarter. Tractor sales dropped 18.1% in September after rising 11.9% in June, according to SBI Research. Mining output contracted by 6.2% in September, shifting from 1% growth previously. SBI Research anticipates overall real GDP growth will moderate further to approximately 6.9% in each of the final two quarters of FY27. SBI Research estimated India's Gross Domestic Product growth at approximately 7.8 per cent for the second quarter of the financial year 2026-27. SBI Research projected India's Gross Value Added growth to range between 8 per cent and 8.2 per cent in the second quarter of the financial year 2026-27. SBI Research projected nominal Gross Domestic Product growth, which includes inflation impact, to be in the range of 11 to 11.5 per cent during the quarter. SBI Research stated that its Dynamic Factor Model utilized 54 high-frequency indicators across agriculture, industry, and services to arrive at the projections.

stories.headline: India Ranks Among Top 10 Branded Residences Markets: Savills
stories.text: India has secured a position among the top 10 global markets for branded residences according to the Savills Branded Residences Report 2026/2027. The global branded residences market is projected to grow by 24 per cent year-on-year by the end of 2026. CNH Industrial signed a definitive agreement with Kobelco Construction Machinery to form a joint venture for its construction equipment business. Kobelco will acquire a 70 per cent stake in the joint venture while CNH retains 30 per cent ownership. The transaction values CNH's construction equipment business at $1 billion, and CNH will receive approximately $700 million in cash. Raimondi Group appointed Roland Trading as the official dealer for its Terex Rough Terrain crane division in Bulgaria. ONGC Videsh holds a 70% stake and operates block CPO-5 in the department of Meta, with GeoPark holding the remaining 30%. ONGC Videsh reported a discovery in October at the Milano-1X well with an initial potential near 750 barrels per day. ONGC Videsh has invested about US$300 million in block CPO-5 since 2008, which includes about US$35 million spent in 2026. The government of Colombian President Abelardo De La Espriella plans to restart new exploration contracts, including fracking, and offer new areas in the first quarter of 2027. The department of Meta accounts for 58.3% of Colombia's crude production.

stories.headline: BEML to build tunnelling machines to cut China reliance
stories.text: State-owned engineering company BEML Ltd. plans to develop tunnel-boring machines to replace foreign suppliers and cut import reliance. BEML Chairman and Managing Director Shantanu Roy stated that the company will initially focus on smaller tunnel-boring machines for metro rail, hydropower, irrigation, and water projects. BEML is onboarding a global consultant to support the effort to eventually gain self-reliance in manufacturing these machines. BEML plans to begin with tunnel-boring machines measuring between 3.5 meters and 6.5 meters in diameter. Shantanu Roy stated that BEML aims to develop proprietary Indian technology rather than just assembling imported kits. Shantanu Roy estimates that India's tunnel-boring machine market could expand about 12% annually over the next seven to eight years. BEML intends to transition into producing larger equipment after starting with smaller machines.

stories.headline: Non-oil goods make up 15% of India’s Russia imports in first half of FY27
stories.text: Non-oil goods formed nearly 15% of India’s total imports from Russia in the first half of 2026-27, according to latest government data. Russia ranks as India's second largest merchandise import source after China, as stated by government data. India imported $40.25 billion worth of crude oil and petroleum products from Russia during the April-September 2026 period. India's imports of coal, coke and briquettes from Russia reached $2.56 billion in H1 of 2026-27, marking a 36% jump compared to the previous year. Russian fertilizer imports saw a year-on-year jump of over 60% to $2.12 billion in H1 of FY27, compared to $1.32 billion in H1 of FY26. India's vegetable oil imports from Russia jumped over 42% to nearly $1 billion in the first half of the current financial year. Deliveries for the contract are scheduled to take place during the first half of 2027. Solid State stated that the contract supports its existing financial guidance for FY2026/27 and FY2027/28. Chief Executive Officer John Macmichael stated that the order underpins existing guidance for FY26/27 and FY27/28.

stories.text: Aeroflex Enterprises recorded an accrual ratio of 0.38 for the year leading up to September 2026. Enterprises Limited experienced an extremely impressive growth rate in its earnings per share over the last three years.

stories.text: Jayant Agro-Organics recorded an accrual ratio of 0.29 for the year leading up to September 2026. Jayant Agro-Organics posted a profit of ₹657.2m during the last twelve months. stories.headline: SEBI directs market intermediaries to update KYC, tax-reporting systems under new income tax rules
stories.text: The Securities and Exchange Board of India instructed registered market intermediaries on Wednesday to update their Know Your Customer and tax-reporting systems. The Securities and Exchange Board of India stated that reporting requirements under the Automatic Exchange of Information framework have been revised for accounts covered under the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act and Common Reporting Standard. The Securities and Exchange Board of India instructed reporting financial institutions to ensure compliance with Rules 238 to 240 of the IT Rules, 2026. Intermediaries must upload Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act and Common Reporting Standard certifications collected from clients to the systems of KYC Registration Agencies. The Securities and Exchange Board of India clarified that the onus of obtaining and reporting certifications and related compliances lies solely with the respective intermediaries. The Securities and Exchange Board of India stated the update aims to ensure compliance with international financial account reporting requirements under revised income tax rules. The Securities and Exchange Board of India warned that failing to include required fields will cause validation errors on the Income Tax portal.

stories.headline: Wix.com (WIX) Earnings Beat Puts Valuation Back In Focus
stories.text: Wix.com reported better-than-expected third-quarter results alongside the rapid expansion of its Base44 AI app platform and the launch of Studio Two. Wix.com recorded a 1-day share price gain of 6.15% following its third-quarter results, though the 1-year total shareholder return was down 48.46%. Wix.com shares traded at US$68.34, which is below the analyst consensus fair value estimate of $79.65. The annualized recurring revenue for Base44 is projected to reach US$150 million by mid May 2026. Freshworks projected fourth quarter revenue between US$253.5 million and US$254.5 million. Freshworks projected full year revenue close to US$965 million. Freshworks 3 year total shareholder return has declined 33.52%. Freshworks closed at $12.08 while the analyst consensus Narrative anchors fair value at $14.79. NextNav reported its Q3 2026 earnings on 10 November, featuring better than expected headline results alongside technical milestones and partnerships. The 30 day share price return for NextNav dropped by 28.21% and the 90 day share price return fell by 56.69%. NextNav carries an analyst consensus fair value of about $33.67 compared to its last close at $8.45.

stories.headline: Gold miners enjoy strong Q2 despite lower gold price, higher expenses and operational disruptions – WGC’s Blagden
stories.text: Oliver Blagden stated that gold producers experienced a strong second quarter in 2026 despite lower gold prices, higher expenses, and operational disruptions. Global average gold producer All-In Sustaining Costs increased by 8% quarter-on-quarter and 22% year-on-year to a record US$1,930 per ounce. Sustaining capital expenditure rose by 34% from the first quarter and 25% year over year to a record-level $441 per ounce in the second quarter. Cash Operating Costs rose by 6% quarter-on-quarter and 18% year-on-year to US$1,215 per ounce, while Total Cash Costs increased by 4% quarter-on-quarter and 22% year-on-year to US$1,406 per ounce. Average royalty and production-tax costs fell by 11% quarter-on-quarter to US$185 per ounce, although they remained 53% higher year-on-year. The average gold price declined by 7.2% quarter-on-quarter to US$4,512 per ounce in the second quarter. Average All-In Sustaining Cost margins contracted by 16% quarter-on-quarter to US$2,582 per ounce, though margins were up by 52% year-on-year. The gold price averaged US$4,266 per ounce in the third quarter of 2026, dropping by 5.5% quarter-on-quarter.

stories.headline: Gold Price Forecast — XAU/USD ($4,013) Holds $4,000 as Fed Hike Odds Hit 100% — $4,300 Target
stories.text: Spot gold traded down at $4,013.30 an ounce in New York following a sharp drop driven by consumer price index data. In India, the 999-purity benchmark for gold was fixed lower at ₹1,40,805 per 10 grams, down ₹1,615. The Federal Reserve is moving toward a December interest rate hike that futures have priced at a 100% probability. Central banks purchased 321 tonnes of gold in the third quarter, representing a 42% increase compared to the previous year. Global gold exchange-traded funds hold a record 4,275 tonnes, which has helped defend the $4,000 price level. The October consumer price index rose 0.4% for the month, exceeding the forecasted 0.3% increase. The 10-year Treasury yield was quoted at 4.998% as cash Treasuries remained closed for Veterans Day. The U.S. Dollar Index rose 0.30% to reach 102.52, contributing to a firmer currency that made gold more expensive.

stories.headline: Crude oil rebounds as expectations for an imminent deal fade amid the lack of US-Iran progress
stories.text: Crude oil prices are edging higher due to the absence of a concrete breakthrough in negotiations between the United States and Iran. Qatar stated that diplomatic efforts secured at least two weeks, while noting that significant differences continue to remain. Crude oil experienced a significant drop following the US midterm elections based on assumptions regarding the Republican party loss. The crude oil CFD contract is rising back above the key 87.00 handle on the daily chart. Buyers may position for a rally targeting the 110.00 resistance level, with the 92.50 level serving as the first target on the 4 hour chart. Sellers will look for the price to fall back below the trendline and the 87.00 handle to target a drop into the 80.00 level. The latest US Jobless Claims figures are scheduled for release tomorrow. The US PPI data release will conclude the week on Friday.

stories.headline: Eastern Pacific Shipping Completes First Truck-to-Ship LNG Bunkering in US
stories.text: Eastern Pacific Shipping completed its first truck-to-ship LNG bunkering operation in the United States. The bunkering operation was performed by the vehicle carrier Lake Victoria located in Davisville. Liquefied natural gas was delivered directly from trucks to the vessel while it was alongside. Truck-to-ship bunkering provides flexibility by allowing liquefied natural gas supply without dedicated bunker vessels or fixed infrastructure. The recent operation builds on Eastern Pacific Shipping having conducted more than 700 liquefied natural gas bunkering operations. Eastern Pacific Shipping recently received the delivery of the world's first ammonia-fuelled very large ammonia carrier. The ammonia-fuelled vessel completed a green ammonia bunkering operation in Ulsan last month.

stories.headline: Crude oil futures fall amid reports of planned US-Iran talks
stories.text: Crude oil futures traded lower on Thursday morning following reports of planned talks between the United States and Iran. January Brent oil futures were recorded at $91.29, declining by 1.58 per cent at 10.02 am on Thursday. December crude oil futures on WTI stood at $85.30, decreasing by 1.42 per cent at 10.02 am on Thursday. November crude oil futures on the Multi Commodity Exchange traded at ₹7995 during the initial hour of trading on Thursday. November natural gas futures on the Multi Commodity Exchange traded at ₹308 during the initial hour of trading on Thursday, marking an increase of 0.69 per cent. November pepper contracts on the National Commodities and Derivatives Exchange traded at ₹799.9 in the initial hour of trading on Thursday. November guargum futures on the National Commodities and Derivatives Exchange traded at ₹16343 during the initial hour of trading on Thursday.

stories.headline: Global OPEC+ oil exports close to prewar levels amid ongoing incidents in Strait of Hormuz
stories.text: Crude oil production by OPEC+ rose sharply in October, approaching pre-war levels, as stated in the group's monthly report released on Wednesday. OPEC+ countries produced an average of 41.23 million barrels per day in October, representing a 2.04 million barrels per day increase from September. Saudi Arabia reported October production of 10.563 million barrels per day, up from 8.372 million barrels per day in September, though OPEC secondary sources estimated it at 9.194 million barrels per day. Iraqi oil production rose from 3.995 million barrels per day in September to 4.491 million barrels per day in October, according to OPEC secondary sources. Iraqi Oil Minister Basim Mohammed Khudair stated in October that Iraqi oil exports exceeded 3.4 million barrels per day, moving toward pre-war levels of approximately 3.7 million barrels per day. The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations reported a tanker incident in the Strait of Hormuz on Wednesday following a separate vessel strike off Oman. OPEC reported that freight rates for very large crude carriers surged in October to more than ten times their levels from a year earlier.

stories.headline: Chennai Gold Rate Today, November 12, 2026: 22-Carat Gold Drops by ₹200 Per Gram
stories.text: Chennai gold prices recorded a decline on Thursday, November 12, 2026, according to the Madras Jewellers and Diamond Traders Association. stories.headline: COMEX gold falls below $4,000 an ounce, silver declines: Key factors investors should track
stories.text: Gold and silver prices dropped in international markets on Thursday, November 12, due to US Federal Reserve interest rate uncertainty and US dollar movements. Silver futures traded at $51.555 per ounce, decreasing $0.447 or 0.86% from the previous close of $52.002 an ounce. In Delhi on Wednesday, November 11, domestic gold prices fell by ₹800 to ₹1.45 lakh per 10 grams, according to PTI. Domestic silver prices in Delhi dropped ₹5,000 to ₹1.87 lakh per kg on Wednesday, November 11, according to PTI. Saumil Gandhi, Senior Analyst at HDFC Securities, stated the domestic fall was partly caused by subdued Diwali trading activity and closed local markets. Persistent inflation and hawkish signals from the US central bank raised concerns that interest rates may stay elevated longer. Brent oil held near $92 as oil remained steady despite a lack of progress in West Asia conflict resolution.

stories.headline: Gold price update, morning of November 12, 2026: SJC, 9999 DOJI rings, BTMC PNJ, Phu Quy.

Spot prices for palladium surged 5.2% to $1,078.56 per ounce, reaching the highest level since October 22nd. Saxo Bank head of commodity strategy Ole Hansen stated that the rise in palladium was mainly driven by short covering and portfolio adjustments.

stories.headline: Troilus hits gold in Quebec ground marked as waste
stories.text: Troilus Mining discovered gold in past-producing ground previously treated as waste at its Quebec project. Hole 87-26-524 intersected 34 metres grading 1.29 grams of gold per tonne starting from 207 metres depth. Desjardins Capital Markets mining analyst Bryce Adams stated that the findings support resource conversion and lower strip ratios. Troilus Mining CEO Justin Reid stated confidence in the existing mine plan while remaining committed to continual improvement. Troilus Mining anticipates construction in 2027, first ore in September 2029, and commercial production in March 2030. Initial capital for the project was estimated at about $1.43 billion or C$2 billion according to Troilus Mining. Shares of Troilus Mining fell 2.8% to C$1.56 Wednesday afternoon in Toronto, resulting in a company valuation of about C$880 million.

stories.headline: BMO says silver’s solar boom is fading, investment demand unlikely to compensate
stories.text: Silver prices are holding above $51 an ounce and are up 0.68% on the day according to Kitco News data. BMO Capital Markets analysts George Heppel and Helen Amos stated that the gold-silver ratio is expected to trade around 85 points over the next four years. BMO Capital Markets analysts stated that silver is losing its primary growth driver due to the solar sector suffering from a glut of renewable energy. BMO Capital Markets noted that silver prices briefly surpassed $120 an ounce earlier this year. BMO Capital Markets reported that the surge in silver prices has incentivized solar manufacturers to accelerate thrifting and replace silver altogether. BMO Capital Markets estimates that the consumption surplus in the silver market will rise to a historical record high by 2030. BMO Capital Markets stated that investment demand will not be enough to offset the loss of demand from the solar sector.

stories.headline: How Daily Thai Gold Price Updates Help People Understand Thailand’s Changing Gold Market
stories.text: The Gold Traders Association of Thailand was founded in 1983 and publishes reference prices that are followed by many shops. Price changes by the Gold Traders Association of Thailand are typically made in steps of 50 baht. Recent announcements for gold bars by the Gold Traders Association of Thailand have shown a gap of about 200 baht per baht weight. One baht weight of a gold bar equals 15.244 grams while jewellery is counted at 15.16 grams. A baht weight of a gold bar holds about 14.71 grams of pure gold because most gold is 96.5% pure. According to The Nation Thailand, the Gold Traders Association of Thailand revised its prices 27 times on one volatile day in July 2026. The records of the Gold Traders Association of Thailand date back to the year 2006.

stories.headline: Altius Minerals agrees to C$122M TNR Gold acquisition
stories.text: Altius Minerals Corporation agreed to acquire TNR Gold Corp. in a transaction valuing TNR at approximately C$122 million. The proposed C$0.48 per share package represents a 60 per cent premium to the Nov. 10 close of TNR Gold Corp. Eligible TNR Gold Corp. shares will be exchanged for 0.0072 Altius Minerals Corporation shares and 0.25 of a share in TNR SpinCo. The valuation comprises C$97 million in Altius Minerals Corporation shares and C$25 million assigned to TNR SpinCo. TNR SpinCo will hold the Shotgun gold project in Alaska along with related assets and liabilities. Shareholders representing about 28 per cent of outstanding shares signed voting and support agreements for the deal. TNR Gold Corp. expects to hold its shareholder meeting in December 2026.

stories.headline: Silver Rate Today in North East Delhi 11th November, 2026 : 1 KG, Todays Silver Price in North East Delhi
stories.text: In North East Delhi, the silver price opened at ₹2,17,000 per KG on November 01, 2026, and settled at ₹2,21,900 per KG by November 10, 2026. Fine silver consists of 99.9% pure silver and is the purest form of silver commonly available to consumers. Sterling silver contains 92.5% silver and 7.5% other metals, typically copper, and is the most common grade used for jewellery. The final showroom price of silver includes the base silver price, making charges that vary by design, and a 3% GST. Digital silver instruments are not regulated by SEBI, and the regulator has cautioned investors about potential risks. Providing a PAN is mandatory for silver purchases exceeding Rs 2 lakh, while cash purchases over Rs 10 lakh require strict KYC compliance. Silver gifts received during marriage or from specified close relatives are tax-free, but gifts exceeding Rs 50,000 in a financial year from others are taxable.

stories.headline: CoreWeave provides silver lining for neoclouds as Nvidia storm swirls
stories.text: CoreWeave shares rose over 16% in premarket trading overnight after reporting a 168% third-quarter revenue spike. CoreWeave shares remain down 65% from their May highs and have lost over 40% of their value in the last month. Nvidia shares rose just over 3% in premarket trading, supporting gains for Broadcom, AMD, Intel, and Nebius. Nvidia sources stated that Jensen Huang held a regular meeting with top-level executives at the Santa Clara, California, headquarters on Monday. Anthropic is offering 825 million shares at a price range of $70 to $78 per share. Sources close to the deal stated that Anthropic plans to price its shares on November 18 and trade on November 19. The U.S. House of Representatives voted down an attempt to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth by a 211-204 margin.

stories.headline: MCX gold rises to Rs 1.41 lakh, silver jumps to Rs 1.87 lakh; Fed uncertainty keeps volatility elevated
stories.text: Gold and silver prices increased in domestic and international markets on November 11 due to a recovery in buying interest. International gold traded 0.38 percent higher near $4,048 per ounce, while international silver increased by 2.72 percent near $53 per ounce. US gold futures surged 0.68 percent to $4,057.80 per ounce. Domestic gold futures for December 4 delivery rose 0.55 percent to Rs 1,41,298 per 10 grams on Multi Commodity Exchange. Domestic silver on Multi Commodity Exchange increased 2.51 percent to Rs 1,87,150 per kilogram over the past 24 hours. Markets assigned an 84 percent probability to a US Federal Reserve rate hike in December, up from 78 percent a week earlier. Carsten Menke, Head of Next Generation Research at Julius Baer, stated that volatility is set to stay elevated in the short term.

stories.headline: India emerges as standout emerging market after US midterm elections: Shriram Research
stories.text: India became a standout emerging market after the US midterm elections, with the Nifty rising 6.8 per cent and the rupee strengthening 1.1 per cent to ₹93.81 per US dollar on November 6, according to Shriram Research. India's 10-year government bond yield dropped by 12.5 basis points and the two-year yield fell by 17.1 basis points by November 6, as stated in the Shriram Research report. Shriram Research reported that India's market performance was driven by falling crude oil prices and a capital rotation from AI-linked stocks in the US, South Korea, and Taiwan. Between November 2 and November 6, the Nasdaq 100 fell 3.6 per cent, South Korea's KOSPI dropped 13.6 per cent, and Taiwan's TAIEX declined 11.6 per cent. Shriram Research stated that India's data centre capacity is forecasted to grow about fivefold to reach 7.5 GW by 2030, needing an estimated investment of around $36 billion. Shriram Research noted that US data centre development restrictions and moratorium risks in Texas and Georgia could cause global hyperscalers to diversify investments into India. Shriram Research warned that India's market gains rely on US and Iran de-escalation because crude oil prices rebounded after an initial post-election drop.

stories.headline: Gold Prices Recover Above $4,040 as Investors Assess Federal Reserve Rate Hike Expectations
stories.text: Spot gold rose 0.22% to $4,041.67 per ounce at 04:56 GMT on Wednesday. US gold futures gained 0.48% to $4,049.52 per ounce on Wednesday. The US Consumer Price Index report for October showed inflation exceeding market expectations. The US Dollar Index increased 0.02% to 102.27 during Wednesday's session. Spot silver gained 1.6% to $52.3730 per ounce on Wednesday. Spot platinum rose 1.7% to $1,566.42 per ounce on Wednesday. Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller raised the possibility of a 50-basis-point increase at the December policy meeting.

stories.headline: Singapore to offer gold storage for foreign central banks in 500-tonne vault
stories.text: Singapore announced plans to provide a gold storage service for foreign central banks and sovereign institutions using a national currency vault with a 500-tonne capacity. The Monetary Authority of Singapore announced the initiative on Tuesday alongside plans to extend tax relief and develop new trading infrastructure. Deputy Prime Minister and Monetary Authority of Singapore chairman Gan Kim Yong stated that growing demand for gold as a reserve asset drove central banks to seek new storage options. The Monetary Authority of Singapore and the Ministry of Finance will consider extending gold-related tax relief from April 2027 to cover wholesale services. Singapore plans to introduce an over-the-counter gold clearing system by the end of 2026. Live trading and market operations for the over-the-counter gold clearing system are expected to start by March 2027. Singapore Exchange plans to launch physically deliverable gold kilobar futures in the second quarter of 2027.

stories.headline: Gold falls 21.4% globally from its peak, but rupee depreciation and higher import duties limit India's...
stories.text: International gold prices denominated in US dollars dropped by 21.4 percent between January 30, 2026, and October 30, 2026, according to an Axis Mutual Fund report. Domestic gold prices in India experienced a smaller decline of 14.9 percent in rupee terms over the same period, according to the Axis Mutual Fund report. The Axis Mutual Fund report noted that the rupee depreciated from around Rs 89 to Rs 96 against the US dollar in 2026. India increased the gold import duty from 6 percent to 15 percent in March 2026, which supported domestic prices. Global gold prices were also impacted by profit-booking and the unwinding of leveraged positions as prices retreated from their January high. Central bank gold purchases reached 57 tonnes in Q1 2026, rebounded to 289 tonnes in Q2, and increased by another 39 tonnes in August. The Axis Mutual Fund report estimates that the US Federal Reserve rate will peak at around 4.25 percent over the next six months.

stories.headline: Markets surge after Diwali; Nifty crosses 25,350 as FII inflows hit ₹53,170 crore this month
stories.text: Benchmark Indian indices opened sharply higher on Wednesday after a holiday for Diwali Balipratipada, with Sensex rising over 1,166 points and Nifty 50 crossing 25,350. IndiGo led the Nifty 50 gainers by rising 3.49 per cent to ₹5,619.40, while Mahindra & Mahindra gained 3.17 per cent to trade at ₹3,394.80. VK Vijayakumar from Geojit Investments Ltd stated that foreign institutional investors aggressively bought equities worth ₹53,170 crore this month. Brent crude is trading near $92 per barrel after dropping over 6 per cent in two sessions, according to the report. Shrikant Chouhan from Kotak Neo advised investors to book profits on existing long positions if the market opens between 25,300 and 25,500 levels. US Consumer Price Index rose 0.4 per cent month-on-month in October, which was higher than the expected 0.3 per cent. Japan’s Nikkei 225 rose 1.2 per cent and South Korea’s Kospi gained 1 per cent, while Hong Kong’s Hang Seng fell 1 per cent.

stories.headline: World Gold Price Plunges Nearly 3% After U.S. CPI, Sliding Close to $4,000/oz Threshold
stories.text: World spot gold prices dropped by 2.7% to $4,028.39/oz during the Nov. 10 session following a higher-than-expected U.S. inflation report. The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics reported that the October consumer price index rose 0.4% month-over-month, exceeding the 0.3% forecast. Edward Meir, an analyst at Marex, stated that the pressure on gold is short-term because inflation data came in slightly higher than expected. The USD Index rose 0.51% to 102.20 points following the inflation report. Standard Chartered noted that gold continues to trade above the $4,000/oz mark while crude oil, inflation risks, and stock market moves shape trading direction. Brent crude closed down 2.1% at $90.64/barrel and U.S. WTI crude fell 1.7% to $85.41/barrel due to eased concerns about supply disruptions from the Middle East. The Monetary Authority of Singapore announced the launch of a gold vault service to store precious metals for foreign central banks and cut taxes for some gold market businesses.

stories.headline: Gold falls to over one-week low on firm dollar, Fed rate hike bets
stories.text: Spot gold dropped 0.2% to $3,981.49 per ounce by 0310 GMT on Thursday, hitting its lowest level since November 4. US gold futures for December delivery declined 0.3% to $3,987.50. The dollar rose to a 19-month high against major peers on Thursday, increasing bullion's cost for holders of other currencies. The probability of a half-percentage-point Federal Reserve rate hike next month increased after Tuesday data showed October US inflation accelerated more than expected. Market participants are awaiting the US Producer Price Index report scheduled for release on Friday. Spot palladium rose 1% to $1,037.25 per ounce among other metals.

stories.headline: Global sugar prices rebound on higher crude oil, short covering; supply concerns persist
stories.text: Global sugar prices closed sharply higher on Wednesday due to rising crude oil prices and short covering in sugar futures. West Texas Intermediate crude oil prices increased by 1% according to barchart. New York sugar futures previously fell to a six-week low on Tuesday driven by a weaker Brazilian real against the US dollar. India's sugar production between October 1 and November 5 reached 1.29 million tonnes according to the Indian Sugar and Bio-Energy Manufacturers Association. Covrig Analytics increased its projected global sugar deficit for 2026-27 to 490,000 tonnes on October 27. The Directorate General of Foreign Trade permitted imports of up to one million tonnes of raw sugar without customs duty on August 20.

stories.headline: OPEC+ oil output rises 2.04 million barrels per day in Oct as Saudi Arabia leads recovery amid West Asia crisis
stories.text: OPEC and partner countries increased their crude oil production by around 2.04 million barrels per day month-on-month to average 41.23 mb/d in October. Brent crude futures traded around USD 91.62 per barrel down 1.2 per cent on Thursday, November 12, while US West Texas Intermediate crude declined 1.2 per cent to USD 85.49 per barrel. Saudi Arabia drove the monthly increase, with its secondary sources-based production rising by 1.18 mb/d to 9.19 mb/d in October. Iraq's oil output increased by 496,000 barrels per day to reach 4.49 mb/d in October. Kuwait's oil production rose by 232,000 barrels per day to nearly 2 mb/d in October. OPEC stated that global oil demand is forecast to grow by about 2.6 mb/d year-on-year in 2027.

stories.headline: Gold rate today: COMEX price slips below $4,000/ounce; ₹1.25 lakh/10 grams in India soon amid US Fed rate hike buzz?
stories.text: During the early morning session on Thursday, COMEX gold dropped below $4,000 per ounce, reaching an intraday low of $3,973.80 per ounce. The COMEX silver price declined to an intraday low of $51.160 per ounce, approaching its 52-week low of $48.050 per ounce. MCX gold traded lower, down by approximately ₹550 per 10 gm at around ₹1,39,000 per 10 gm. MCX silver traded lower by over ₹1,700 per kg, staying below the ₹1,83,000 per kg level. Vikram Subburaj, CEO of Giottus.com, stated that stronger-than-expected US inflation data has heightened expectations of Federal Reserve tightening. Market expert Anuj Gupta noted that aggressive positions are being squared off due to Christmas and New Year holidays following the December US Fed meeting.

stories.headline: Nasdaq futures slide on Huang Ouster report | Crude oil prices rangebound
stories.text: Wall Street closed higher with the Dow rising 0.49 percent, the S&P 500 increasing 1.31 percent, and the Nasdaq gaining 1.60 percent. Nasdaq futures declined following reports that Nvidia's board is preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang. The Nifty closed at a fresh nine-month high above 25,200, while the Nifty Bank approached its record high. Brent crude oil prices remained steady around $92 a barrel due to geopolitical tensions involving the US and Iran. Foreign Portfolio Investors extended their buying spree with November net buying reaching $7.3 billion in seven sessions. Bajaj Finance launched a ₹11,700 crore QIP.

stories.headline: Flattish opening seen for Indian stocks; markets eye release of inflation data
stories.text: Indian stocks are expected to open flat to negative on Thursday due to cautious market sentiment. Gift Nifty traded at 25,240 indicating a flattish opening for the Nifty index. Investors are closely monitoring the October CPI inflation data for India scheduled for release on Thursday. The US 10-year Treasury yield was hovering near 4.99% according to Hariselvan Radhakrishnan. Brent crude was trading near $92 a barrel reflecting expectations of de-escalation in US-Iran tensions. Angel One cautioned that technical and market-breadth indicators have been pushed into overbought territory.

stories.headline: Peru's mining exports hit $57.5 billion in eight months, with copper and gold driving a 55% year-over-year surge
stories.text: Peru reported that mining exports reached US$21.649 billion in the first three months of 2026, marking a 56.2% increase compared to the same period in 2025. Copper shipments from Peru reached US$22.843 billion through July 2026, representing a 54.7% jump over the same period in 2025, with China absorbing 73.2% of the exported value. Cumulative mining exports for Peru crossed US$42.221 billion by the end of June 2026, representing a 56% advance compared with the first half of 2025. Gold exports reached US$21.631 billion between January and August 2026, showing an increase of 58% from the previous year's comparable period. Copper generated US$26.513 billion between January and August 2026, which was up 54.8% compared to the same window in the previous year. Peru's total exports reached a historic US$90.082 billion in 2025, representing a 21% year-on-year increase and marking the fifth straight year of record export growth.

stories.headline: Gas prices estimate rises for 2027, though consumers could still see relief from pain at the pump: EIA
stories.text: The Energy Information Administration reported in its November report that retail gasoline prices are projected to average $3.73 a gallon in 2027. The Energy Information Administration raised its 2027 gasoline price estimate by 5% compared to the agency's outlook from the previous month. The Energy Information Administration's forecast for diesel projects retail prices at $5.03 a gallon in 2027. The Energy Information Administration projects Brent crude oil spot prices to fall to an average of $77 a barrel in the fourth quarter of 2027. Data from AAA showed that the United States national average price for gasoline fell to $3.97 a gallon. The United States national average gasoline price dropped to $3.94 a gallon on Wednesday.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia Keeps Increasing Its Oil Production. OPEC+'s Output is Now Near Pre-Iran War Levels.
stories.text: OPEC+ oil production returned close to pre-Iran war levels after pumping over 41 million barrels per day last month. Saudi Arabia produced over 10.5 million barrels per day, driving nearly the entire increase in output from September. Russia increased its production by 41,000 barrels per day. OPEC+ projects global demand will grow by more than 2.5 million barrels per day in 2027 to reach an average of 108.3 million barrels per day. Saudi Arabia plans to store crude oil at Singapore's Jurong Rock Caverns starting in the second half of 2027. Singapore's Jurong Rock Caverns sit 492 feet underground and can store up to 9 million barrels of liquid hydrocarbons.

stories.headline: Saudi Arabia Tells OPEC Output Surged 26% to 10.563M Bpd in October
stories.text: Saudi Arabia told OPEC that its crude oil production surged to 10.563 million barrels per day in October. OPEC secondary sources estimated Saudi October production at 9.194 million barrels per day, creating a gap of 1.369 million barrels per day from the self-reported figure. Across the broader OPEC+ group, October output totaled 41.23 million barrels per day compared to 42.72 million barrels per day in February. Iranian crude output dropped to 1.9 million barrels per day in October, marking the lowest level in Bloomberg survey records dating back to 1989. Iraq produced 4.888 million barrels per day in October, which is its highest output level since the war began. Saudi Aramco reduced its November Arab Light price for Asia by $3 to a six-year low.

stories.headline: Saudis Tell OPEC Production Surged to Highest Since War Began
stories.text: Saudi Arabia informed OPEC that its crude oil production rose by 26% last month to the highest level since before the war began. Saudi Arabia boosted its output to 10.56 million barrels a day in October according to an organization report. Brent oil futures declined approximately 21% this month to reach $93 a barrel. Iraq informed the organization that it increased its output to a new war-time high of nearly 4.9 million barrels a day. Saudi Aramco Chief Executive Officer Amin Nasser stated last week at an industry conference in Abu Dhabi that the company intends to maximize production in the fourth quarter. The full OPEC+ alliance is scheduled to meet online on November 29 to deliberate output targets for 2027.

stories.headline: Diesel still costing close to a ‘dismal’ £2 a litre despite oil price falls
stories.text: The average price of diesel on UK forecourts stays near the record high of £2 a litre, currently costing 197p according to the AA. Petrol prices have fallen 6p to an average of 168p from a peak of 174.7p reached in early October. US Federal Reserve governor Christopher Waller stated that energy costs are likely to remain elevated due to geopolitical and logistical constraints. Christopher Waller noted that insurance and ship-to-ship oil transfers to guard against Iranian attacks are boosting oil prices by $20 to $30 a barrel. The AA stated that wholesale costs for unleaded petrol have dropped below 62p after previously falling from 77p to 68p in the second half of October. Luke Bosdet from the AA stated that northern England, Wales, and Scotland feature bargain petrol prices below 160p, while London and the south-east do not.

stories.headline: Gold or Silver? Which investment will offer higher returns after rates correction? What experts say; key levels to watch
stories.text: Kaveri More from Choice Broking stated that gold remains the preferred choice for stability, capital preservation, and portfolio diversification, whereas silver offers higher upside potential with greater volatility. Kaveri More noted that silver corrected by nearly 60% from its January 2026 peak to its low, with the gold-to-silver ratio hovering around 77–80. Gaurav Arora from SAHI stated that gold declined about 28% and silver nearly 50% from their January peaks, with October declines of about 7% for gold and 20% for silver. Gaurav Arora noted that US Federal Reserve's October rate decision featured two members voting for a rate hike, with growing market expectations of a possible hike in December. Gaurav Arora highlighted that crude oil prices above $100 per barrel added to inflation concerns and reinforced fears of further monetary tightening. Gaurav Arora identified ₹ 1,38,250 as an important support level for Multi Commodity Exchange gold and ₹ 1,78,800 for silver.

stories.headline: FTSE 100 Rises 0.8% as Oil Price Recovery Supports Energy Shares Ahead of UK GDP Data
stories.text: The FTSE 100 rose 0.8% on Wednesday, driven by gains in energy stocks as crude oil prices rebounded from two-month lows. Crude oil prices rebounded on Wednesday after reaching two-month lows on Tuesday due to Middle East developments and shipping disruption concerns. Government bond markets faced selling pressure after the US Consumer Price Index report showed inflation exceeding market expectations. US monetary policy expectations increasingly reflected the possibility of a 25-basis-point Federal Reserve interest rate increase in December. Regional Federal Reserve officials made comments contributing to discussions about the potential for a larger 50-basis-point adjustment. The Office for National Statistics is scheduled to release third-quarter UK GDP data and September production figures on Thursday.

stories.headline: Bank Nifty surges 3% to nearly 61,400 as crude prices fall; BoB, PNB, Yes Bank rally up to 6%
stories.text: On Wednesday, the Nifty Bank index surged over 1,653 points, or 2.76 percent, to cross the 61,350 mark. The Nifty Bank hit a high of 61,394.30 on Wednesday. Brent crude futures fell to a two-month low of $89.16 per barrel. Bank of Baroda emerged as the top gainer among the 14 constituents of the Nifty Bank, rising 6 percent. Punjab National Bank gained 4.71 percent and Federal Bank gained 4.21 percent. The Nifty Financial Services index rose 2 percent, taking its monthly gains to 13 percent.

stories.headline: Crude Oil Rebounds as Hormuz Attacks Revive Supply Fears
stories.text: Crude oil prices advanced on Wednesday, November 11, recovering from a two-month low following attacks on commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. Brent crude futures rose 1.14% to $92.5 per barrel, and US West Texas Intermediate crude gained 0.7% to $86.7 per barrel. The Washington Institute for Near East Policy stated that 37 vessels were attacked in the Strait of Hormuz and surrounding waterways in October. The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency reported that a tanker was struck northeast of Oman’s Lima on Tuesday. Analysts at LSEG stated on November 10 that increased shipping flows would depend on mine clearance operations, insurance costs, and shipowner willingness. Industry sources told Reuters that Russia’s oil refining capacity declined by approximately 30% since late October following Ukrainian drone attacks.

stories.headline: Global gold price drop 2026: Yellow metal slips 6% in dollar terms, but top Indian gold ETFs still deliver 7.5% returns
stories.text: Global gold prices declined by over 6% in 2026, with year-to-date returns at -6.36% and trading around $4,045 per troy ounce on 11 November. Indian gold ETFs delivered positive returns with top performers generating gains of over 7.5%, cushioned by a weaker Indian rupee against the US dollar. Quantum Mutual Fund reported that gold ended 30 October at $3,875 per troy ounce, marking a monthly decline of approximately 6.87%. Global gold ETFs recorded cumulative net inflows of $1.2 billion through 23 October, and aggregate holdings increased by approximately 10 tonnes in October. LIC MF Gold ETF recorded the lowest year-to-date return of 1.98% among the listed funds as of 9 November 2026. Quantum Mutual Fund stated the October correction was driven by rising oil prices, persistent inflation, tighter US monetary policy expectations, and elevated real bond yields.

stories.headline: Conversion/Switch of Government of India Securities
stories.text: Market participants must place their bids through the Reserve Bank of India Core Banking Solution platform known as e-Kuber. Bidding for the switch auction is scheduled to take place on November 16, 2026, from 10:30 AM to 11:30 AM. The settlement for the conversion auction is scheduled to be held on November 17, 2026. The quoted price for the source security must equal its FBIL closing price from the previous working day.

stories.headline: Crude oil from northern Iraq smuggled to Iran, Afghanistan
stories.text: Crude oil and petroleum products are smuggled from Kirkuk and Sulaymaniyah fields into Iran through Bashmaq and Parviz Khan border crossings, per an Iraqi intelligence investigation. The smuggling network transports the supplies to the Iranian border using small and medium-sized tanker trucks. Once inside Iran, the smuggled Iraqi oil is combined with Iranian petroleum products at small refineries. The mixed gasoline is sold under false origin certificates to evade international restrictions and is re-exported mainly to Afghanistan. Iraq’s Federal Commission of Integrity opened an investigation targeting the oil smuggling network.

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty open largely unchanged day after sharp rally amid easing crude oil prices
stories.text: Sensex and Nifty opened largely unchanged on Thursday after a sharp rally driven by foreign inflows, easing crude oil, and cooling AI trade. GIFT Nifty futures stood at 25,270 at 8 am, while the Nifty 50 closed at 25,255.05 on Wednesday. Foreign portfolio investors bought shares worth ₹ 12,563 crore on Wednesday, bringing November net purchases to $6.43 billion. HST Wealth founder and CEO Hariselvan Radhakrishnan noted that the US 10-year Treasury yield hovered near 4.99 per cent. MSCI added Adani Green Energy, Coforge, Life Insurance Corporation of India, and Meesho to the MSCI India index while removing PI Industries.

stories.headline: Japan's October Corporate Goods Price Index Rises 7.1%, Pushed Up by Crude Oil Prices and AI Demand; About 90% of Items Post Gains
stories.text: The Bank of Japan announced on the 12th that Japan's October domestic Corporate Goods Price Index reached 136.8. Japan's October domestic Corporate Goods Price Index increased by 7.1% year-on-year, widening by 0.3 percentage points from the previous month's 6.8%. Prices rose for roughly 90% of all items in the October domestic Corporate Goods Price Index survey. In major categories, non-ferrous metals recorded the highest growth rate at 31.7% year-on-year due to surging copper prices. Petroleum and coal products rose 15.9%, information and communications equipment rose 15.9%, and chemical products rose 15.5% year-on-year.

stories.headline: GIFT Nifty up, signals steady start for Sensex, Nifty; Nvidia plunges 8% after hours, crude oil falls
stories.text: GIFT Nifty traded at 25,255 around 7:45 am, rising 30 points or 0.12 percent. Sensex rose 0.95 percent to 81,879.40 and Nifty gained 0.84 percent to 25,255.05 on Wednesday. Foreign institutional investors bought equities worth Rs 12,563 crore on Wednesday. Domestic institutional investors sold shares worth Rs 8,434 crore on Wednesday. Nvidia shares plunged more than 8 percent in after-hours trading.

stories.headline: How Gold Price Volatility Will Impact Newmont Shares Investors
stories.text: Newmont reported that all in sustaining costs increased by about 25% year on year in Q3 2026. Newmont anticipates another step up in costs in Q4 2026 as capital spending peaks and silver output at Penasquito decreases. Newmont's analyst consensus narrative forecasts revenues of $31.4b and projected earnings of $11.9b by 2029. Newmont's forecast earnings growth is projected at 4.41% annually. Optimistic analysts previously estimated about US$40.2b of revenue and US$14.8b of earnings for Newmont by 2029.

stories.headline: Crude Oil Prices Finish Higher as Progress Stalls in US-Iran Peace Talks
stories.text: December WTI crude oil closed up +0.49 or +0.57% on Wednesday, while December RBOB gasoline closed down -0.0013 or -0.05%. Mohsen Rezaee stated that his country would not give up enriched uranium and that ending the war in Lebanon is a condition for talks with the United States. Saudi Arabia reported that its October crude production rose by +970,000 bpd to 9.2 million bpd. The International Energy Agency raised its estimate for this year's global oil deficit to 1.7 million bpd on September 11. US crude oil production in the week ending October 30 rose +0.1% week-over-week to a record high of 14.003 bpd.

stories.headline: $30 LNG meets the thinnest European storage of the decade
stories.text: Liquefied natural gas is currently trading above $30 per MMBtu for the Northern Hemisphere winter 2026/27. Europe is entering the winter season with the lowest gas storage of the 2020s decade. Europe will need to pay high prices to prevent United States cargoes from being diverted to Asia. Northeast Asia faces conditions including expensive liquefied natural gas and improved nuclear availability that are curbing gas demand and increasing coal burn. Henry Hub prices in the United States are expected to reach a peak of around $4 per MMBtu while being insulated from global price rallies.

stories.headline: India raises fertilizer subsidy by 64%, vastly overshooting budget estimates amid global price surge
stories.text: The Union Cabinet approved a ₹62,370.02 crore fertilizer subsidy for the 2026-27 Rabi season, which is ₹24,417.73 crore higher than the previous Rabi season. Global prices of urea and LNG increased significantly following the Iran war, leading to an expected total fertilizer subsidy outgo of up to ₹3.50 lakh crore for FY27. Controller General of Accounts reported that total fertilizer subsidy spending in the six months up to September exceeded 70 per cent of the FY27 budget estimates. India's total fertilizer stocks were 235.21 lakh tonnes as of November 10, 2026, compared to 173.46 lakh tonnes on the same date in the previous year. Fertilizer Association of India Chairman S Sankarasubramanian stated that the enhanced financial support will ensure adequate availability of phosphorus and potassium fertilizers at affordable prices. Bank of Baroda Chief Economist Madan Sabnavis stated that the fiscal deficit ratio will be higher up to 0.3 per cent of GDP. For the Rabi season from October 2026 to March 2027, the subsidy on nitrogen will be ₹94.21 per kg. The Centre has estimated the fertilizer demand in the current rabi season at about 350 lakh tonnes based on feedback received from States.

stories.headline: FII drive Nifty rally; all eyes on inflation print
stories.text: The BSE Sensex opened at 81,762.27 on Thursday and traded up 128.71 points at 82,008.11 in early trade. The NSE Nifty 50 opened at 25,213.50 and stood at 25,285.70, rising 30.65 points at 9.21 am. Foreign institutional investors bought equities worth ₹12,563 crore on November 11, pushing their November total to ₹65,735 crore. Domestic institutional investors sold ₹8,434 crore, marking their ninth straight session of net selling. Dr. V K Vijayakumar from Geojit Investments stated that FII inflows could reach an all-time high driven by strong Q2 results and softer crude prices. MCX December gold dropped ₹795 to trade at ₹1,39,730 per 10 grams due to hotter-than-expected US inflation data. The India VIX increased to 17.55 to signal near-term market volatility while the RSI hit 79.49. The Indian rupee closed at 93.69 against the US dollar on Wednesday after gaining 24 paise.

stories.headline: Japan top currency diplomat says yen’s recent fall ‘too rapid’
stories.text: Japan's top currency diplomat Atsushi Mimura stated on Nov 12 that the yen's recent drop has been too rapid. The comments followed the Japanese currency slipping toward 160 against the US dollar. Atsushi Mimura noted it is too early to forget a joint Japan-US foreign exchange market intervention from earlier in the summer. The US dollar traded around the mid-159 yen line following the statements by Atsushi Mimura. The US Federal Reserve was expected by dealers to raise its key interest rate due to stronger-than-expected US consumer inflation data. Financial markets anticipated the Bank of Japan could proceed with another interest rate increase during its December meeting. The current policy rate of the Bank of Japan stood at 1.25%, remaining lower than rates in the United States and Europe. Japan previously carried out interventions during the summer, which included a joint action with the United States on July 31.

stories.headline: Inflation rises to 2.8% in Oct. as energy prices climb 12.2% in Germany
stories.text: Germany recorded an inflation rate of 2,8 percent in October 2026 according to final data from the Federal Statistical Office. Energy prices in Germany increased by 12,2 percent in October 2026 compared to October 2025. Food prices in Germany increased by 0,4 percent year-over-year in October 2026. Goods prices in Germany rose overall by 3 percent year-over-year in October 2026, with consumer goods increasing by 4,7 percent and durable goods by 0,3 percent. Prices in the German services sector increased by 2,5 percent in October 2026 compared to October 2025. Rental prices in Germany contributed to the overall inflation trend with a year-over-year increase of 1,9 percent in October 2026. Eurozone inflation accelerated to 4% in October 2026, reaching its highest level in three years. Energy prices in the eurozone surged amid the conflict in the Middle East according to Qazinform News Agency.

stories.headline: NIESR urges Bank of England to push rates to 5% as inflation threatens to linger until 2030
stories.text: The National Institute of Economic and Social Research urged the Bank of England to raise interest rates from 4% to 5%. NIESR warned that price growth may not return to the 2% target until 2030. NIESR identified the effects of the Iran war as the principal force driving sticky inflation and elevated borrowing costs. Approximately three-quarters of UK workers are scheduled to agree pay settlements in the first three months of next year. NIESR estimates that raising interest rates to 4.75% would reduce GDP growth by 0.4 percentage points in both 2028 and 2029. Chancellor John Healey could miss his fiscal rules by up to £30bn according to NIESR calculations. The Bank of England forecast inflation to peak at 4.9% by July next year before declining to 2% in 2028. Governor Andrew Bailey stated he could see the argument for raising interest rates to 4.25% if energy prices remained elevated.

stories.headline: Bank of England’s inflation response ‘risks higher interest rates for longer’
stories.text: The National Institute of Economic and Social Research stated that the Bank of England's recent interest rate increase risks keeping UK inflation above the 2% target until at least 2030. The Bank of England raised borrowing costs from 3.75% to 4%. National Institute of Economic and Social Research director David Aikman stated that UK inflation is projected to rise above 4% in the new year. UK inflation is currently at 3.5%, exceeding the Bank of England's 2% target. Brent crude oil traded below $90 at one point on Tuesday, marking the lowest price since August 31. The S&P 500 index declined by 0.9% by early afternoon on Wall Street after US inflation rose by 0.4 percentage points from September to October. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research projects the UK economy to grow by 1.6% this year and 0.9% in 2028. Chancellor John Healey faced criticism for deferring difficult budget decisions, which could create a £30bn shortfall in government finances.

stories.headline: Who is Kimberly Powell? What we know about the Nvidia executive with whom CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair
stories.text: The New York Times reported that Nvidia co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang allegedly had an extramarital relationship with Nvidia Vice President of Healthcare Kimberly Powell. Kimberly Powell joined Nvidia in 2008 and was promoted to senior director in 2016 and vice president of healthcare in 2017. According to The New York Times, 48-year-old Kimberly Powell and 63-year-old Jensen Huang were captured on video being affectionate at a San Jose, California, hotel in March. Nvidia's code of conduct mandates that employees avoid personal relationships that create conflicts, and the company stated it promptly investigates misconduct reports. Following reports of the affair, The Wall Street Journal stated that Nvidia's board is working with an outside firm to identify potential replacements for Jensen Huang. According to Bloomberg, the Nvidia board considered appointing a temporary chief and met on Wednesday to discuss Jensen Huang's fate. Nvidia's board previously opened an investigation after Jensen Huang admitted to having an affair with Alice Huang, a Singapore-based business executive suspected of being a Chinese spy.

stories.headline: Dabur sharpens pricing, cuts 350 SKUs as Middle East conflict fuels inflation
stories.text: Dabur India is responding to inflation fueled by the Middle East conflict by adjusting its product portfolio, pricing, and costs. Dabur India CEO Herjit Bhalla stated that elevated inflation has made consumption growth challenging for the FMCG sector. Dabur India reported 11.6% growth in consolidated revenue in the September quarter. Dabur India's standalone business grew 8.9% with margin dilution limited to 10 basis points. Dabur India's India FMCG revenue grew 10.7%, consisting of 5.5% volume growth and 5.2% pricing growth. Dabur India has eliminated six brands and 350 stock keeping units as part of a portfolio simplification exercise. Dabur India's Project Samriddhi cost-saving programme generated over ₹115 crore, and the company is targeting ₹170-200 crore.

stories.headline: Reverse AI trade drives foreign inflows back to India but rising US inflation poses challenge: Ajay Bagga
stories.text: According to NSDL data, foreign investors pumped over Rs 53,000 crore into Indian equities in November following two consecutive months of selling. Ajay Bagga noted that India witnessed foreign outflows of more than USD 70 billion over the last two years, making it an under-invested and underweight market for global institutional investors. Ajay Bagga stated that declining crude oil prices following a partial resolution of the Iran conflict have helped improve India's inflation outlook, current account deficit, and currency. Ajay Bagga identified sectors such as financials and capital goods as those attracting foreign investment due to strong government capital expenditure over the last 6 years. The latest US Consumer Price Index data showed headline inflation rising 0.4 per cent month-on-month and core inflation increasing 0.3 per cent. Ajay Bagga stated that it is a certainty that the US Federal Reserve will hike interest rates on 9th December. Ajay Bagga is forecasting a total of three US interest rates hikes, consisting of one in December and two more by June next year.

stories.headline: South Korean Government Bond Yields Surge Across the Board on U.S. Inflation Shock; 3-Year Closes at 3.729%
stories.text: South Korean government bond yields jumped sharply across the entire curve following higher-than-expected U.S. inflation data and Federal Reserve comments. The yield on 3-year South Korean government bonds closed at 3.729%, increasing by 9.6bp from the previous trading day. The U.S. Department of Labor stated that the October consumer price index rose 0.4% month-on-month, surpassing the 0.3% market forecast. Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller stated that if inflation remains elevated, a 50bp rate hike in December could be justified. The United States 10-year Treasury yield closed at 4.99%, rising 11bp after the inflation data and a $42 billion 10-year note auction. Ahn Ye-ha, an analyst at Kiwoom Securities, stated that all U.S. inflation indices exceeding expectations and the possibility of a big step acted as upward factors. The ICE Dollar Index increased by 0.7% to reach 102.36 as the dollar strengthened following the rise in U.S. Treasury yields.

stories.headline: Moody’s ups growth forecast for India to 7%, cautions high inflation
stories.text: Moody's Ratings increased India's growth forecast to 7 per cent for the fiscal year 2026-27, rising from its previous estimate of 6.5 per cent. The Reserve Bank of India raised its real GDP growth forecast for the 2026-27 financial year to 7.1 per cent. The World Bank increased India's growth forecast for the current fiscal year by 50 basis points to 7.1 per cent. Moody's cautioned that potential policy interest rate hikes by the Reserve Bank of India could impact private investment. Moody's stated that headline inflation is currently close to the upper limit of the Reserve Bank of India target range of 2-6 per cent. The Reserve Bank of India projected Consumer Price Index inflation for 2026-27 to be 5.2 per cent. The Reserve Bank of India projected core inflation at 4.4 per cent for the 2026-27 period.

stories.headline: Oil relief to revive rupee rally, US yields surge could act as brake
stories.text: The Indian rupee is expected to resume its recent rally on Wednesday, supported by softer oil prices according to traders. A jump in United States Treasury yields following faster-than-expected inflation could act as a dampener for the Indian rupee. Traders expect the Indian rupee to open in the range of 93.70 to 93.74 against the dollar. On Monday, the Indian rupee settled at 93.93275 to the dollar. Indian financial markets were closed on Tuesday for a local holiday. Brent crude slid below $90 a barrel on Tuesday for the first time since August. United States officials played down the need for further military action against Iran, tempering fears of Middle Eastern oil supply disruptions.

stories.headline: CDL shares fall 8% after developer warns of significantly weaker second half
stories.text: City Developments Limited stated that persistent inflation and elevated interest rates delayed expected deal completions for 2026. City Developments Limited noted that the appreciation of the Korean won against the Singdollar caused foreign exchange losses. City Developments Limited and its joint venture partners sold 124 units worth $322.6 million in the third quarter. City Developments Limited launched the 570-unit Lucerne Grand in Lakeside in October. City Developments Limited plans to launch the Wynwood Grand and Solano Grand projects in the first quarter of 2027. City Developments Limited reported a net gearing of 75% as at Sept 30.

stories.headline: Inflation Fears Keep Treasury Yields Elevated, but Is the Market Overreacting?
stories.text: The yield premium on the US 10-year Treasury note surged in October due to investor demands for compensation regarding inflation and fiscal risks. Annual headline CPI inflation accelerated to an estimated 4.0% in October, marking the highest reading since May. Core CPI rose to an estimated 2.9% in October, reaching a 13-month high. Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that the economic campaign against Iran is devastating and there is no need for further military action. President Donald Trump cited positive momentum toward resolving the conflict involving Iran. Fed funds futures are pricing in a roughly 90% probability that the Federal Reserve will raise its target interest rate by a quarter point at the Dec. 9 FOMC meeting.

stories.headline: Singapore Airlines backs Air India despite billion-dollar losses
stories.text: Singapore Airlines reaffirmed its commitment to Air India, stating the Tata Group-backed carrier is progressing in its transformation. For the six months ended September, Singapore Airlines' net profit fell 44% to S$133.9 million. Singapore Airlines' share of Air India's losses was S$361.7 million in April-September, down from S$429.5 million a year ago. Tata Sons chairman N. Chandrasekaran estimates that Air India's turnaround would take 5 to 10 years. Air India reported a consolidated net loss of ₹ 22,238 crore for FY26, while revenue declined to ₹ 70,086 crore. IndiGo reported a September-quarter net loss of ₹ 1,879 crore due to higher fuel costs and rupee depreciation.

stories.headline: Global markets broadly rise on AI chip demand despite Wall Street's retreat on inflation data
stories.text: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. climbed 3.1 per cent after reporting October revenue nearly sixfold higher than a year earlier. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.'s board approved up to USD 1 billion in investment in Anthropic and OpenAI. SoftBank Group reported a quarterly net loss of 1.1 trillion yen, equal to USD 7 billion, on Tuesday. India's Sensex rallied 0.9 per cent to reach its highest level in six months.
