Nvidia fell 5.5 per cent as the single heaviest weight on the S&P 500 amid an investigation into its CEO. Anthropic stated in a filing that it is seeking a valuation of roughly USD 1.3 trillion.

stories.headline: US Treasury yields surge, Wall Street falls on inflation surprise
stories.text: The US Consumer Price Index rose 0.4 percent in October, exceeding the forecast of 0.3 percent. The two-year US Treasury yield climbed 18.44 basis points to reach 4.731 percent. The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield increased by 12.55 basis points to 4.988 percent. Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller stated that a core inflation reading of 0.3 percent would make him consider a 50-basis-point rate increase at the December 8–9 meeting. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 157.86 points, or 0.30 percent, to close at 52,231.89. Spot gold dropped 2.62 percent down to $4,030.56 an ounce.

stories.headline: UK inflation to overshoot Bank of England target for next 4 years, think-tank forecasts
stories.text: The National Institute of Economic and Social Research stated on Tuesday (Nov 10) that the Bank of England will not return inflation to target before 2030. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research forecast that United Kingdom inflation will peak at 4.4 per cent in February 2027. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research projects the United Kingdom economy will grow 1.6 per cent in 2026. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research expects wage growth in the United Kingdom to average 3.9 per cent over the coming three years. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research expects the Bank of England to raise interest rates only once, in February. The Bank of England raised interest rates to 4 per cent from 3.75 per cent last week.

stories.headline: New Found Gold Reports Q3 2026 Financial and Operational Results
stories.text: New Found Gold reported producing 4,863 ounces of gold at Hammerdown during the third quarter of 2026, alongside 10,670 ounces year to date. During the three months ended September 30, 2026, New Found Gold generated $41.6 million in revenue from metal sales. New Found Gold reported cash and cash equivalents of $167,111,584 and a working capital surplus of $167,272,288 as of September 30, 2026. New Found Gold released a revised Preliminary Economic Assessment and updated Mineral Resource Estimate for Queensway on October 22, 2026.

stories.headline: EIA sees Brent near $100/bbl through yearend 2026 as Middle East supply constraints persist
stories.text: Brent crude oil spot prices are forecast by the US Energy Information Administration to average about $100/bbl in November and December. US commercial crude inventories dropped by 14.1 million bbl in October to about 410 million bbl, marking the lowest end-of-October level since 2014. The US Energy Information Administration forecasted that average US retail diesel prices in 2027 will rise by 12% from its October outlook to reach $5.03/gal. Henry Hub spot prices are forecast by the US Energy Information Administration to average $2.87/MMbtu from November through March.

stories.headline: OPEC Forecasts Global Oil Demand to Grow by 2.6 Mmbbl/d in 2027
stories.text: The Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries expects global oil demand to grow by 2.6 million barrels per day in 2027 and 200,000 barrels per day in 2026. The Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries projects global oil demand to average 105.7 million barrels per day in 2026 and rise to 108.3 million barrels per day in 2027. Liquids production in non-Declaration of Cooperation countries is forecast to increase by 600,000 barrels per day in both 2026 and 2027. Crude oil production by Declaration of Cooperation countries increased by 2.04 million barrels per day month over month in October to average 41.23 million barrels per day.

stories.headline: JSW Dulux navigates volatile crude oil, cost pressures to drive volume growth
stories.text: JSW Dulux plans to aggressively pursue market expansion strategies following resilient double-digit volume growth despite macroeconomic headwinds and volatile crude oil pricing. Managing Director and CEO Rajiv Rajgopal stated that JSW Dulux maintained its growth trajectory despite input cost spikes like a recent 2 per cent anti-dumping duty on chemicals. Consumer demand remains strong for JSW Dulux due to real estate expansion and discretionary home improvement projects. JSW Dulux industrial segments posted double-digit growth driven by heavy demand across automotive original equipment manufacturers, power, oil and gas infrastructure, marine applications, and coil coatings.

stories.headline: China CITIC Bank to launch pending-order feature for gold accumulation plan next Monday as Chinese banks jostle amid sharp gold price swings
stories.text: China CITIC Bank announced that it will add a pending-order function to its personal Gold Accumulation Plan starting from November 16, 2026. Bank of Changsha announced that its commission rate on personal gold accumulation purchases and regular investment deductions will drop to zero from 0.5% between now and December 31, 2026. COMEX gold is hovering around $4,050 an ounce, which is approximately 30% below its year-to-date high. China's gold reserves reached 78.3 million ounces at the end of October, marking an increase of 830,000 ounces from the previous month.

stories.headline: Trump says Iran war ‘effectively over’: How's it likely to impact Sensex, Nifty, gold and silver prices? Experts' views
stories.text: US President Donald Trump stated that the Iran war is effectively over, raising hopes of easing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Mahesh M Ojha noted that the immediate upside targets for the Nifty are 25,400, 25,600 and 25,740-plus. Mahesh M Ojha stated that 82,500 is an important level for the Sensex to sustain above, with resistance at 83,300 and 85,600. Mahesh M Ojha identified key downside support levels for the Sensex at 80,630, 80,170 and 79,800.

stories.headline: We Think That There Are More Issues For Mafatlal Industries (NSE:MAFATIND) Than Just Sluggish Earnings
stories.text: Mafatlal Industries reported weak earnings recently, although the report did not trigger a large movement in the stock price. Mafatlal Industries recorded an accrual ratio of 0.29 for the year leading up to September 2026. Mafatlal Industries posted a negative free cash flow with an outflow of ₹1.7b during the last twelve months. Mafatlal Industries generated a profit of ₹480.0m over the last twelve months despite the cash outflow. Mafatlal Industries registered a free cash flow figure of ₹1.4b a year prior to the latest reported period. Mafatlal Industries experienced a decline in earnings per share over the past twelve months. Ambuja Cements Limited's recent earnings report showed weak results that did not cause a big stock movement. Ambuja Cements Limited's profit was reduced by ₹2.5b due to unusual items over the last year. Ambuja Cements Limited received a tax benefit which contributed ₹10b to the bottom line.

stories.headline: Indonesia rupiah drops to record low on strong US dollar, MSCI woes
stories.text: The Indonesian rupiah weakened by as much as 0.3% to 18,204 per US dollar on Nov 12. The Nov 12 level surpassed the previous record low of 18,190 per US dollar recorded in early June. The Federal Reserve is expected by some to resume raising interest rates in December. Goldman Sachs Group estimated about US$5.6 billion of passive outflows if Indonesia is reclassified as a standalone market. The Indonesian rupiah is down more than 8% against the US dollar in 2026, making it the worst performer in Asia.

stories.headline: October CPI seen at 6%; key inflation print ahead of RBI’s December policy
stories.text: According to a CNBC-TV18 poll of economists, India's retail inflation is projected to reach the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit of 6% in October. The upcoming October Consumer Price Index reading serves as the final inflation data accessible to the Reserve Bank of India prior to its December 4 monetary policy decision. Economists predict that food inflation will climb to 8.5% from September's figure of 7.75%, propelled primarily by high vegetable prices. Core inflation, which leaves out food and fuel, is projected to hold steady at roughly 4.51%. The Consumer Price Index data is compared against the preceding month rather than the prior year because the index has been rebased from February 2026.

stories.headline: Fed’s Bowman Says AI Now Drives About a Quarter of America’s Excess Inflation
stories.text: Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman stated that artificial intelligence-related price pressures accounted for roughly one-fourth of above-target core personal consumption expenditures inflation over the 12 months ending in September. Michelle Bowman estimated that 12-month core personal consumption expenditures likely rose to 3.3% in October and noted that the October consumer price index increased 0.4%. NASDAQ:NVDA shares closed Tuesday at $168.89, declining 5.47%, before trading at $177.46 around 1:32 p.m. ET on November 11. Microsoft quarterly capital expenditure reached $39.367 billion, with approximately three-quarters allocated to short-lived assets like GPUs and higher-cost memory. Futures early on November 11 priced an 88.5% probability of a quarter-point rate hike and an 11.5% probability of a half-point adjustment.

stories.headline: Wall Street thinks the Fed made a 'mistake' — and now more hikes are coming
stories.text: Wall Street analysts adjusted forecasts after three consecutive months of bad inflation data, with price increases recorded in food, rent, medical care, and electronics. Federal Reserve governor Christopher Waller proposed a 50 basis point hike for December based on October data. Bank of America analysts stated that the October rate hold is considered a policy mistake and warned that central bankers are falling behind the curve on inflation. Goldman Sachs analyst David Mericle forecasts that the Federal Reserve will implement a third rate hike in March. David Mericle predicts that inflation will decrease meaningfully by the end of 2027 as the impacts of tariffs, the energy shock, and AI pricing pressures subside.

stories.headline: INDIA RUPEE-Rupee touches strongest since April as foreign inflows offset firm dollar
stories.text: The Indian rupee reached its highest level against the dollar since April on Wednesday. The Indian currency finished trading at 93.69 per dollar on Wednesday. The Indian rupee gained 0.2% on the day after reaching a peak of 93.6350 in afternoon trading. Foreign inflows into local equities and non-deliverable forward market activity helped support the Indian rupee. The Indian rupee previously dropped to an all-time low of 96.96 in May.

stories.headline: Lenders in Europe and Latin America Report Results as a Fed Governor Leans Toward a Hike
stories.text: The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers increased 0.4 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in October after a 0.6 percent rise in September, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. Federal Reserve Governor Christopher J. Waller stated he is leaning toward supporting a 25 basis point policy rate increase at the December FOMC meeting, or potentially 50 basis points if October core CPI remains around 0.3 percent or higher. Banco Santander, S.A. reported its first nine-month underlying profit increased 16% to €11.2 billion in 2026, with third-quarter underlying profit reaching €3.8 billion, up 19%. Credicorp Ltd. reported third-quarter net income attributable to the company reached S/1,929.4 million, representing an 11.0% year-over-year increase, and reaffirmed its 2026 ROE guidance of about 19.5%. Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. reported a recurring managerial result of BRL 12.6 billion for the third quarter of 2026 with a recurring ROE of 23.6% and a total loan portfolio of BRL 1.5 trillion.

stories.headline: Inflation seen hitting RBI's 6% ceiling in October, putting rate policy in focus
stories.text: Official Consumer Price Index data for October is scheduled to be released on 12 November. Gaura Sengupta, chief economist at IDFC First Bank, stated that they expect the Reserve Bank of India to hike policy rates by 25 basis points. Aditi Nayar, chief economist at Icra, noted that the food and beverages division is expected to record inflation of more than 8% in October. During its October monetary policy review, the Reserve Bank of India raised its inflation projection for 2026-27 to 5.2% from 5% earlier. The Reserve Bank of India expects inflation to average 6% in the October-December period before moderating to 5.7% in January-March.

stories.headline: Germany October inflation slows, but winter energy risks keep ECB rate hike bets alive
stories.text: Germany's final October inflation report confirmed the preliminary report's findings regarding the easing of price pressures in Europe's largest economy. The easing of price pressures in October in Germany was largely driven by a slower increase in energy prices and the introduction of temporary fuel tax cuts starting on October 1 through the end of the year. Core annual inflation in Germany was reaffirmed at 2.1% in October, dropping from 2.4% in September. Approaching winter and low gas storage levels are expected to push up gas prices in coming weeks, potentially translating to higher retail and consumer prices at the start of next year. Market odds price in a roughly 79% probability for a 25 bps rate hike by the European Central Bank in December.

stories.headline: U.S. October CPI Beats Expectations, Sparking Bond Market Selloff; 10-Year Yield Briefly Tops 5%
stories.text: The U.S. 10-year Treasury yield briefly broke through 5% on Tuesday before settling at 4.996%, up 11.17 basis points. The U.S. 2-year yield soared 18.46 basis points to 4.742% on Tuesday, marking the largest single-day increase since April of last year. The U.S. Labor Department reported that the headline consumer price index rose 0.4% month-over-month in October, exceeding economists' forecast of 0.3%. Core CPI rose 0.3% month-over-month in October, surpassing the expected 0.2% increase. The U.S. Treasury auctioned $42 billion of 10-year notes on Tuesday at a high yield of 5.020%.

stories.headline: GIFT Nifty signals strong start for Sensex, Nifty; Asian markets gain as US inflation fuels Fed rate hike...
stories.text: The GIFT Nifty traded 286 points or 1.1 percent higher than the Monday afternoon session's close, signaling a strong start for the Sensex and Nifty on Wednesday. Foreign institutional investors bought equities worth Rs 7,212 crore on Monday. Domestic institutional investors sold shares worth Rs 7,172 crore on Monday for an eighth consecutive session. The US Consumer Price Index increased 0.4 percent in October according to data from the US Labor Department. Ponmudi R, CEO of Enrich Money, stated that Indian equities appeared well positioned to extend their recent advance.

stories.headline: Hot US inflation report seals Federal Reserve rate increase
stories.text: About 90 per cent of traders expect the US Federal Reserve to raise interest rates by 25 basis points in December, while about 10 per cent expect a larger increase of 50 basis points. Dallas Fed president Lorie Logan stated she supports raising the interest rate at least two more times. US Federal Reserve governor Christopher Waller stated that maritime insurance and ship-to-ship transfers of oil are raising oil prices by between $20 and $30 a barrel. The yield on the 10-year US Treasury climbed back to 5 per cent after the consumer price index inflation report. The yield on the 30-year US Treasury rose more than 10 basis points to 5.36 per cent.

stories.headline: Pre-Market Update: GIFT Nifty Signals Higher Opening; US Inflation, Treasury Yields and Q2 Earnings in Focus
stories.text: GIFT Nifty indicated a firm opening for domestic equities on November 11, 2026, trading at 25,326.5 at 7:01 AM IST. U.S. October headline Consumer Price Index increased by 0.4 per cent month-on-month, while core Consumer Price Index rose by 0.3 per cent. The Department of Pharmaceuticals invited fresh applications under the revamped production-linked incentive scheme for medical devices, which has an outlay of around Rs 2,700 crore. Foreign institutional investors recorded net purchases of Indian equities worth Rs 7,212.22 crore, whereas domestic institutional investors were net sellers worth Rs 7,172.53 crore. Ashoka Buildcon received a Letter of Acceptance from the National Highways Authority of India for balance work worth Rs 865.9 crore.

stories.headline: Interest rates should rise to 5% to control inflation, says think tank
stories.text: The National Institute of Economic and Social Research stated that interest rates in the UK need to rise to 5% to properly control inflation. New forecasts by the National Institute of Economic and Social Research indicate that UK Consumer Prices Index inflation will peak at approximately 4.4% in February. The Bank of England raised interest rates to 4% last week. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research expects UK gross domestic product to grow by 1.6% this year. The National Institute of Economic and Social Research projects UK gross domestic product growth to slow to 1.1% next year.

stories.headline: Angola’s Oil Windfall Fuels Diversification Push, Citi Says
stories.text: Citigroup Inc. stated that Angola is advancing its efforts to diversify the economy away from oil. Citigroup Inc. reported that the government is utilizing a surge in crude revenue to finance structural reforms. Citigroup Inc. noted that the funds are being used to invest in energy, transport, and other industries.

stories.headline: Nigeria’s October crude output averages 1.69 million bpd, meeting OPEC quota for sixth month
stories.text: Nigeria’s crude oil output averaged 1.69 million barrels per day in October according to upstream regulator data. Nigeria's oil production peaked at 1.79 million barrels per day during October. Nigeria's oil production dipped to 1.60 million barrels per day during October.

stories.headline: Top 2 stocks to buy for short-term: Canara Bank, Pine Labs by Nagaraj Shetti - Check stop loss, targets
stories.text: The Nifty 50 advanced 0.84% to close at 25,255.05 on Wednesday, while the Sensex rose 0.95% to 81,879.4. Foreign portfolio investors pumped nearly $6 billion into Indian equities in November. Nagaraj Shetti of HDFC Securities recommended buying Canara Bank at ₹ 132.15 with a target of ₹ 143 and a stop-loss of ₹ 126.

stories.headline: Sensex losses early gains, falls nearly 500 points from day’s high
stories.text: Foreign portfolio investors purchased $5.68 billion worth of Indian shares in November, marking their biggest monthly buying spree since September 2024. Foreign institutional investors purchased equities worth ₹ 7,212.22 crore on Monday according to exchange data. VK Vijayakumar stated that the Nifty-50 surged by 8.6 per cent in just seven trading days of this month.

stories.headline: Mainland Chinese overseas funds find winners in oil, US stocks as Hong Kong bets struggle
stories.text: Mainland Chinese mutual funds investing overseas have delivered sharply diverging returns this year. Products tied to energy and US stocks outperformed other assets. Funds tracking Hong Kong equities lagged behind other overseas investments.

stories.headline: Emerging Asian equities rally as oil slides after Trump's Iran remarks
stories.text: Emerging Asian equities rallied on Tuesday, driven by technology shares in South Korea and Taiwan as oil prices fell. US President Donald Trump stated he was unlikely to order new military strikes on Iran after appeals from countries like Qatar. South Korea's Kospi closed 4.4% higher and Taiwan shares rose 2.5% following the activation of a market stabilisation fund. Samsung Electronics jumped 4.5% and SK Hynix soared 7.2% in Seoul, while TSMC lifted the Taipei market. Markets awaited US inflation data due later in the day, which could reinforce expectations of a Federal Reserve interest rate hike. James Ooi, chief market strategist with Tiger Brokers, stated that last week's technology sell-off may have been excessive. The South Korean won strengthened to 1,336.61 per dollar, alongside gains in the Indonesian rupiah and Philippine peso. Markets in India were closed on Tuesday for a holiday.

stories.headline: Annual electric car and SUV sales cross 300,000 units for the first time in India
stories.text: Retail sales of electric passenger vehicles in India surpassed 300,000 units for the first time in a calendar year, reaching 304,701 units between January 1 and November 9. Tata Motors sold 120,895 electric vehicles in the past 10 months and nine days of November, becoming the first electric carmaker to register over 100,000 units in a calendar year. Mahindra & Mahindra achieved a 23% e-PV market share with 69,660 e-SUVs sold, recording its highest monthly sales in October at 8,702 units. JSW MG Motor sold 56,988 electric vehicles with a 19% market share, ceding its former number two position to Mahindra & Mahindra. Vinfast entered the Indian market 15 months ago and secured the fourth position with 15,867 electric vehicles sold and a 5% market share. Maruti Suzuki ranked fifth with 12,390 e-Vitara SUVs and a 4% e-PV market share, anticipating increased domestic production at its Hansalpur plant in Gujarat. Luxury EV sales in India reached 7,323 units across nine manufacturers, marking a 29% increase over the 5,669 units sold in CY2025. BMW retained the top position in the luxury electric vehicle segment by selling 4,273 units, capturing a 58% share of that sub-segment.

stories.headline: Trade Spotlight: How should you trade Devyani International, FACT, Federal Bank, MCX India, Samvardhana...
stories.text: Devyani International surged 4.26 percent to close at Rs 132.03 after breaking out of its falling channel. Fertilizers and Chemicals Travancore registered a breakout by surging 8.67 percent to close at Rs 813.25. Sky Gold and Diamonds gained 4.55 percent to close at Rs 983.40 following a correction from its high. Federal Bank broke out above a downward-sloping trendline, with a recommended accumulation zone of Rs 359–364. Canara Bank is recommended for accumulation in the Rs 130–134 zone with a stop-loss at Rs 129. MCX India scaled a fresh all-time high on November 11 after breaking out of its consolidation range. PNB can be considered for accumulation in the Rs 132–140 range with an upside target of Rs 160. Samvardhana Motherson International is trading at a current market price of Rs 169.69 after breaking out from a falling channel.

stories.headline: Oil prices drop more than US$1 as hopes for Iran, Ukraine peace talks pressure markets
stories.text: Oil prices fell by more than US$1 on Thursday due to optimism regarding peace talks concerning the Middle East and the Russia-Ukraine conflicts. Brent futures decreased by US$1.14, or 1.2%, reaching US$91.62 a barrel by 0141 GMT. US West Texas Intermediate crude futures dropped US$1.04, or 1.2%, to US$85.49. Hiroyuki Kikukawa, chief strategist of Nissan Securities Investment, stated that markets are declining due to expectations of a Russia-Ukraine ceasefire effort and a lack of escalation in the Iran war before the upcoming US-China summit. Russian and Ukrainian negotiators agreed to a major prisoner exchange during two days of peace talks in Abu Dhabi that concluded on Wednesday. Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei stated in televised remarks that Iran will not allow any enriched nuclear material to leave the country and warned of consequences if the United States launches new strikes. Crude oil production by Opec+ increased in October, driven by a sharp rise in output from Saudi Arabia. US crude stocks increased by nine million barrels in the latest week according to data from the American Petroleum Institute.

stories.headline: Oil rises on mixed signals over Iran war outlook
stories.text: Global oil prices climbed on Nov 11 as traders evaluated mixed signals regarding the outlook for the Iran war. West Texas Intermediate futures increased above US$86 a barrel following a decline of about 5% over the prior two days. Brent closed close to US$93 a barrel amid ongoing market uncertainty over the regional conflict. Saudi Arabia informed OPEC that its crude production increased 26% in October to 10.56 million barrels a day. The American Petroleum Institute reported that US crude inventories rose by nine million barrels during the previous week. The Energy Information Administration projected that retail gasoline prices would average US$3.73 a gallon in 2027. The Energy Information Administration forecasted that diesel prices would average US$5.03 a gallon in 2027. The Energy Information Administration maintained its US crude production forecast at 14.3 million barrels a day.

stories.headline: CBG plant capacity utilisation in India low at around 35%: IEA
stories.text: The International Energy Agency reported that compressed biogas plant capacity utilisation in India sits low at roughly 35 per cent. The International Energy Agency stated that expansion could face delays due to challenges in securing sufficient feedstock and logistics constraints. In the year 2025, 79 per cent of compressed biogas produced in India was delivered using pressurised cylinders transported on trucks. India currently maintains approximately 1,944 tonnes per day of commissioned compressed biogas capacity. The Gobardhan portal shows that India counts 2,099 registered compressed biogas plants, with 1,344 plants operating as functional. The Gobardhan scheme operates with a budget of ₹23,700 crore to accelerate compressed biogas production through multiple support mechanisms. The compressed biogas price is established at ₹2,110 per million British thermal units alongside capital assistance up to ₹2 crore per tonne per day. The International Energy Agency projects India to reach exponential compressed biogas production growth by 2031.

stories.headline: Wheelock Place renamed Landmark Orchard after $1.1 billion acquisition by Hongkong Land
stories.text: Property group Hongkong Land renamed Wheelock Place to Landmark Orchard, marking the first time the Landmark name is used outside Hong Kong. The renaming became effective on Nov 12, following the acquisition of the Orchard Road property by Hongkong Land’s Singapore Central Private Real Estate Fund three months prior. Hongkong Land’s Singapore Central Private Real Estate Fund agreed in July to pay about $1.1 billion for the property to an entity owned by Wharf Real Estate Investment Company. The 21-storey building has existed in Orchard Road for over 30 years, containing offices and shops with a direct link to Orchard MRT station.خ Hongkong Land announced plans to improve Landmark Orchard, though specific details were not disclosed. Foo Pei Teng, chief executive of the Singapore fund, stated that the group intends to apply its long-term investment approach to Landmark Orchard. The Singapore Central Private Real Estate Fund is targeting approximately $15 billion in assets under management.خ

stories.headline: Sensex, Nifty May Open Higher as Rotation Boosts Sentiment
stories.text: Indian equity benchmarks Sensex and Nifty are projected to open higher on Thursday, November 12, 2026. Japan’s Nikkei 225 increased by 0.8% in early trading on Thursday, November 12, 2026. South Korea’s Kospi advanced by 1% in early deals on Thursday, November 12, 2026. MSCI’s broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan dropped by 0.03%. Nvidia shares dropped in after-hours trading following reports that the board considered removing CEO Jensen Huang. The S&P 500 rose 1.31% to close at 7,619.38 on Wednesday. Brent crude futures declined 0.9% to $91.9 per barrel in early trade on Thursday, November 12, 2026.

stories.headline: Hong Kong business leaders examine investment opportunities under city’s first Five-Year plan
stories.text: Over 30 senior business leaders from various sectors gathered yesterday to discuss Hong Kong's first five-year plan and investment opportunities. The closed-door SCMP C-Suite roundtable was co-organised by the South China Morning Post and the Hong Kong Investment Corporation. Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po attended as guest of honour while Hong Kong Investment Corporation CEO Clara Chan served as a guest speaker. The roundtable discussion explored how Hong Kong's development strategy aligns with China's 15th Five-Year Plan. Financial Secretary Paul Chan Mo-po outlined Hong Kong's economic priorities and reaffirmed its status as an international financial centre and innovation hub. Participants examined cross-boundary collaboration opportunities in technology and healthcare regarding the Northern Metropolis development. The discussion highlighted the Hong Kong Investment Corporation utilizing patient capital to draw in private investment and support technology companies.

stories.headline: Hindustan Aeronautics, Vodafone Idea, Hitachi Energy India and 7 Other Stocks Announcing Q2 Results Today
stories.text: Hindustan Aeronautics will announce its financial results on 12 November 2026. Vodafone Idea reported that its net loss narrowed to ₹3,754 crore in Q1 FY27 from ₹6,608 crore a year ago. Hitachi Energy India posted a standalone revenue jump of 68.6% to ₹2,494 crore in Q1 FY27. Oil India recorded a consolidated revenue climb of 47% to ₹12,886 crore in Q1 FY27. Ola Electric Mobility saw its consolidated revenue fall 45% year-on-year to ₹455 crore in Q1 FY27. Bharat Dynamics achieved a standalone revenue surge of 130.8% to ₹572 crore in Q1 FY27. Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation reported a flat net profit of ₹330 crore for Q1 FY27.

stories.headline: Whirlpool of India Limited Earnings Missed Analyst Estimates: Here's What Analysts Are Forecasting Now
stories.text: Whirlpool of India Limited reported a statutory earnings per share of ₹1.98 for its half-year results released last week, missing analyst forecasts by 45%. Whirlpool of India Limited recorded revenues of approximately ₹46b for the half-year results, which was in line with analyst estimates. Analyst consensus expects Whirlpool of India Limited per-share earnings to increase by 32% to ₹24.43 in 2027. Prior to the latest earnings report, analysts anticipated Whirlpool of India Limited to reach revenues of ₹89.8b and earnings per share of ₹25.96 in 2027. The consensus price target for Whirlpool of India Limited remained unchanged at ₹939 following the latest earnings report. Among analysts covering Whirlpool of India Limited, the most bullish valuation is ₹1,202 per share while the most bearish price target is ₹712. Analysts expect Whirlpool of India Limited to experience an annualised growth of 12% to the end of 2027, compared to a historical growth of 6.1% per annum over the past five years.

stories.headline: Nissan reduces petrol car production as EV sales boom in China
stories.text: Nissan reduced petrol car manufacturing and increased production of battery electric vehicles and plug-in hybrids in China. Nissan lowered its overall sales forecasts for the year to between 2.97 million and 3 million cars. Ivan Espinosa stated that demand in China is weaker and competition is intensifying faster than expected. Nissan reported that its sales across China dropped by 22% in the first half of the year. Nissan noted that its sales were down 32% in the first nine months of the year due to intensified pressure. Nissan has lobbied in the UK to weaken the zero-emission vehicle mandate and continue selling petrol cars past 2035. Autotrader reported that retail sales of used electric vehicles increased by 56% year on year in October.

stories.headline: US-Backed Lithium Americas Hit by Rising Costs on Trump Tariffs
stories.text: Lithium Americas Corp. raised the estimated cost to build the Thacker Pass lithium mine in Nevada by almost $900 million due to Trump administration tariffs, higher labor costs, and logistics expenses. The first phase of construction for the Thacker Pass project is now projected to cost $3.83 billion, an increase from the previous estimate of $2.93 billion. TD analyst Craig Hutchison stated that the increased costs will negatively impact the value of Thacker Pass amid weakened lithium prices. Lithium Americas Corp. stock has experienced a decline of approximately 60% over the course of the year. General Motors Co. holds a stake in the Thacker Pass project after making a commitment of $625 million. Lithium Americas Corp. estimates that the revised budget creates an additional funding requirement of approximately $995 million for the project. Lithium Americas Corp. stated that the increased price tag will not alter the construction schedule, which targets production to begin in 2028.

stories.headline: ITV to cut show budgets as UK TV and film production spend drops by more than £2bn
stories.text: Broadcaster ITV plans to implement temporary savings of £30m, which includes £25m in content and £5m in other areas of the business. ITV expects advertising revenues to decrease by between 5% and 10% in the final quarter of the year, with a full-year drop of 2% to 3%. The British Film Institute reported that UK spending on film and high-end TV show production dropped by £2.08bn year on year to £5.2bn in the year to the end of September. Carolyn McCall, chief executive of ITV, attributed weakened ad demand to macroeconomic uncertainty, increased digital advertising on global streaming platforms, and a new 9pm watershed rule for less healthy food advertising. Shares of ITV, listed on the London FTSE 250 index, fell nearly 4% in trading on Wednesday and have lost about a fifth of their market value since the beginning of the year. Culture Secretary Lisa Nandy issued a public interest intervention notice, prompting an investigation by Ofcom and the Competition and Markets Authority regarding ITV's proposed £1.6bn sale to Sky. Lisa Nandy expressed concern that the combined broadcasters would control about 86% of linear news and current affairs viewing in Britain, alongside worries about US political influence over editorial independence.

stories.headline: India’s Winter Crop Sowing Falls Sharply After Weak Monsoon
stories.text: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare data showed early wheat sowing slumped by over 94 percent to 19,000 hectares from 3.34 lakh hectares a year earlier. Pulses acreage dropped by 51.69 percent to 9.45 lakh hectares, with chickpea acreage decreasing by 58.91 percent to 5.90 lakh hectares. Oilseed sowing declined by 45.7 percent to 20.97 lakh hectares, driven by a 46.16 percent drop in rapeseed and mustard acreage to 20.50 lakh hectares. Experts attributed the slow sowing start to a 13 percent deficient June to September monsoon that reduced residual soil moisture. A senior agriculture ministry official stated on November 6 that it is still too early to draw conclusions because rabi sowing continues through December. Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan chaired a review meeting and directed officials to accelerate rabi planting using residual soil moisture. Union Agriculture Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan advised farmers with limited irrigation access to prioritize short-duration and drought-tolerant crops over water-intensive options.

stories.headline: Qualcomm India layoffs: Over 1,000 jobs at risk amid global cuts
stories.text: More than 1,000 jobs are estimated to be at risk in India as Qualcomm carries out a global workforce reduction. Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon described the exercise in an internal memo on October 19 as a performance-focused reduction. Pareekh Jain, CEO of EIIRTrend, estimated that approximately 1,000 Indian employees could be affected by the cuts. Qualcomm reported its global workforce at approximately 57,000 as of September 27, 2026, in its annual report filed on November 4. Qualcomm reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $43.12 billion, which represents a 3% decrease year-on-year. Qualcomm reported that its fourth-quarter revenue fell 8% to $10.32 billion. Qualcomm's non-GAAP net income declined by 15% to $11.31 billion.

stories.headline: India bans export of battery ‘black mass’ to cut import dependence for EV, storage sector
stories.text: India banned the export of lithium-ion battery black mass to retain critical minerals within the country and reduce import dependence. The Directorate General of Foreign Trade prohibited the export of lithium-ion battery black mass through a notification issued on November 10. Black mass is a powdery material obtained from shredding end-of-life lithium-ion batteries and manufacturing waste containing lithium, cobalt, nickel, and manganese. The commerce and industry ministry spokesperson stated that the measure ensures feedstock for domestic recyclers and strengthens clean-energy supply chains. The prohibition applies to waste, scrap, and spent primary cells, batteries, and electric accumulators that are unsorted and lack lead, cadmium, or mercury. India possesses growing battery recycling and refining capacity that remains underutilized due to a lack of sufficient feedstock. The ban complements the National Critical Mineral Mission, which includes a ₹ 1,500 crore incentive scheme approved by the Cabinet in September 2025.

stories.headline: The ₹5 digital lifeline: The quiet turf war over India’s sachet internet
stories.text: India launched the Prime Minister’s Wi-Fi Access Network Interface scheme in December 2020 to expand affordable broadband access via local shops and small businesses without requiring a licence. Government data on the PM-WANI website shows that only 432,906 public Wi-Fi hotspots were deployed as of 9 November this year, falling short of the 10 million target set for 2022. Data from the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India indicates that public Wi-Fi hotspots in locations like malls, airports, and coffee shops reached 56,222 by March end. In 2025-26, Omnia Information Pvt Ltd, owner of the Wi-Fi aggregator Wiom, reported a 56.4% revenue increase to ₹ 33.3 crore, while its losses widened to ₹ 99.3 crore. Wiom co-founder and CEO Satyam Darmora states that for ₹ 5 and ₹ 10 public Wi-Fi sachets, 70% of gross transaction value goes to the ISP, with the remaining 30% split equally between Wiom and the homeowner. In August this year, Bharti Airtel established ₹ 349 as its new entry-level plan after removing its ₹ 299 plan offering one GB of data per day, though it later brought back the ₹ 299 plan due to customer churn. The Cellular Operators Association of India stated in June that affordable mobile broadband services in India have substantially reduced consumer need for public Wi-Fi access.

stories.headline: Despite the sanctions, China Telecom Europe does business with Russia
stories.text: China Telecom Europe aims to recover bad debts in Russia by purchasing additional services from Russian operators to offset mutual debts. China Telecom Europe filed its 2025 annual accounts on 21 October with the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register. China Telecom Europe set aside a provision of £3.19m, equal to €3.81m, to cover amounts owed by Russian customers. China Telecom Europe explicitly excluded Russia's leading telecommunications operator, Rostelecom, from the provision of €3.81m. Rostelecom has been subject to US restrictions on transactions concerning certain new debt and new shares since March 2022. China Telecom Europe generated a turnover of €420.15m in 2025, marking a 33.6% increase year-on-year. China Telecom Europe reported that its net profit more than doubled, increasing from €3.15m to €6.89m.

stories.headline: Ukraine, Russia resume US-led peace talks in Abu Dhabi; Black Sea, energy ceasefires on agenda
stories.text: Ukraine and Russia began a second day of US-led peace talks in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday focusing on de-escalation measures. Negotiators in Abu Dhabi on Wednesday were scheduled to focus on possible ceasefires covering the Black Sea and energy infrastructure. Tuesday's discussions covered humanitarian steps, territorial issues, security guarantees, and a potential exchange of up to 1,500 prisoners each. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated that the talks in Abu Dhabi were very productive. Russian Deputy Foreign Minister Sergei Ryabkov stated that it was too early to talk about progress in the negotiations. A drone attack caused a fire in the port area of Ust-Luga, which is one of Russia's biggest Baltic oil export hubs, according to Leningrad region Governor Alexander Drozdenko. Russian strikes on energy targets in Ukraine's southern Odesa region left approximately 135,000 households without power, regional Governor Oleh Kiper stated.

stories.headline: US Treasury chief Scott Bessent is reportedly latest Trump official to move to military base
stories.text: The US Treasury secretary, Scott Bessent, has relocated from his Washington-area home to a military base due to an alleged threat to his life from Iran. Scott Bessent has driven a US push to cripple Iran's economy through sanctions since the Middle East war began. Scott Bessent bought a Georgetown mansion for $12.5m (£9.4m) in January 2025. The US national intelligence chief, Jay Clayton, stated last month that Tehran increased efforts to target Americans. The strait of Hormuz has been largely closed since the US and Israel attacked Iran on 28 February. Scott Bessent has led the sanctions and economic pressure campaign against Iran named Operation Economic Outcast since August. A US Treasury spokesperson stated that Scott Bessent remains committed to executing Operation Economic Outcast and maintaining the blockade.

stories.headline: Chinese AI firms rush to secure Nvidia chip capacity as spy scandal stirs fear of US curbs
stories.text: Chinese artificial intelligence companies are attempting to rent computing capacity powered by Nvidia outside China due to fears of tighter United States restrictions. The United States House of Representatives passed the Remote Access Security Act in January by a 369-22 vote, awaiting Senate action. Jensen Huang stated on Sunday that he had been unfaithful to his wife. Alice Huang is a former executive at Megaspeed, a cloud-computing company based in Singapore. Traders and intermediaries in China's grey market are stockpiling restricted Nvidia AI chips due to fears of tougher enforcement and a broader United States crackdown. A Chinese university linked to the People's Liberation Army purchased Nvidia H200 AI chips last month despite being on a United States export blacklist.

stories.headline: Sensex today | Stock Market Live Updates: Sensex, Nifty edge down in opening trade
stories.text: HiLITE Group launched a ₹200 crore Shariah-certified AIF named HiLITE Ethical Fund 1 targeting high-net-worth individuals with a real estate focus. Yes Bank bondholders filed a contempt petition in the Supreme Court last week through their trustee asking the lender to comply with an order to restore its AT-1 bonds. Hindustan Copper surged over 3% to Rs 451.45 on the NSE, reporting a Q2 PAT of Rs 519.54 crore. HFCL secured international export orders worth approximately ₹834.36 crore ($88.94 million) for Optical Fibre Cables through its overseas wholly-owned subsidiary. Bajaj Finance launched a qualified institutional placement to raise up to ₹11,700 crore ($1.25 billion) at an indicative issue price of ₹1,025 per share. On the MCX, December gold was quoted down Rs 795 or 0.57% at Rs 1,39,730 per 10 grams, while December silver was up Rs 97 or 0.05% at Rs 1,84,622 per kg.

stories.headline: Iran warns of expanded retaliation as Israel reportedly readies to attack
stories.text: Israel's security cabinet chaired by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu instructed the military on Wednesday evening to intensify preparations for a potential attack on Iran, according to Israeli media reports. Iranian security chief Mohsen Rezaei stated on social media that any military base involved in US aggression would become a legitimate target for lethal strikes from West Asia to Europe. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio indicated that the economic pressure campaign against Iran is working well enough that a return to extensive military action is unnecessary. Global oil prices increased by approximately 1 percent on Wednesday following Iran's rejection of a US proposal regarding its stockpile of 60 percent enriched uranium. Brent futures settled higher by $1.27 or 1.39 percent at $92.76 on Wednesday. US West Texas Intermediate crude increased by 49 cents or 0.57 percent to reach $86.53 on Wednesday.

stories.headline: Where is Alice Huang? Alleged Chinese spy in Jensen Huang extramarital affair scandal reportedly living in Beijing
stories.text: Alice Huang, also known as Alice Wong and Huang Le, is currently living in Beijing, China, according to Bloomberg reports. US intelligence and officials believe Alice Huang was recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to gather information on American AI hardware and get close to Nvidia leadership. Megaspeed International founder Alice Huang served as managing director from March to November 2023, and the company is under US investigation over potential chip smuggling. Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang admitted to having an extramarital affair with Alice Huang. Megaspeed International was spun off from 7Road Holdings Ltd in 2023 following US restrictions on advanced AI chip shipments to China. Megaspeed International imports of Nvidia products have topped $4.6 billion, according to trade records.

stories.headline: What we know so far about Nvidia partner Megaspeed’s Asia footprint
stories.text: Singapore cloud computing firm Megaspeed International is scrutinized over suspicions it facilitated billions of dollars of restricted Nvidia chips to China. Megaspeed International saw its assets increase to about $3 billion in 2024 from $33 million in 2023, while revenue rose to $294 million. Culper Research alleged in May that Megaspeed International and its Malaysian subsidiary Speedmatrix received funding connected to Chinese tech giant Alibaba. Megaspeed International stated in December 2025 that inspections by the U.S. Commerce Department and other bodies found no evidence of violations. Malaysian subsidiary Speedmatrix purchased at least $4.8 billion in advanced AI equipment containing Nvidia chips between June 2024 and February 2026. Malaysia's Investment, Trade and Industry Minister Johari Abdul Ghani stated Tuesday that his ministry had not opened an investigation into Speedmatrix.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO draws multiple times the available orders: Why Wall Street sees it as a test of the AI boom
stories.text: Anthropic has attracted orders several times higher than its available shares for its initial public offering, according to Bloomberg reports. Anthropic is seeking to raise up to $90.4 billion through an initial public offering and private share placement. Anthropic is aiming for a fully diluted valuation of approximately $1.4 trillion for the market debut. Anthropic is scheduled to price its initial public offering on Wednesday, November 18, with trading to begin the next day. Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley are leading Anthropic's initial public offering, alongside 20 other participating banks. Anthropic's shares are planned to list on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol ANT.

stories.headline: Iraqi PM orders inquiry into oil product smuggling in area controlled by Iran-backed militia
stories.text: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Al Zaidi ordered an investigation into petroleum product siphoning and smuggling on Wednesday. The Interior Ministry's Federal Intelligence and Investigations Agency reported smuggling activities in Jurf Al Sakhar, an area controlled by Kataib Hezbollah. The agency's report used satellite imagery from 2021 to 2026 to document illegal extraction near pipelines across four sites. Large tankers with a capacity of 36,000 litres repeatedly appeared at the illegal extraction sites. The Iraqi government faced resistance regarding bringing armed factions' weapons under state control, pushing the deadline back to June 30, 2027 at the earliest. The Integrity Commission opened an investigation regarding crude oil smuggling from fields in Kirkuk and the Kurdistan Region to Iran and Afghanistan.

stories.headline: Iran Targets Navigation Systems on Oman's Didmar Island, Threatening Oil Flows Through Hormuz
stories.text: Iran targeted maritime navigation systems on Oman's Didmar Island in the Strait of Hormuz, threatening oil flow infrastructure. Tehran claimed responsibility for the attacks on Tuesday, according to sources speaking to Reuters. Shipping industry and maritime security sources stated the attacks are likely to have a limited effect because backup systems are available. Iranian state media reported on Tuesday that the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps launched strikes destroying navigation systems on Didmar Island. Reuters confirmed smoke rising from Didmar Island in video footage, and an EU Copernicus satellite image showed thermal activity. Gulf oil exports rose to more than 80 percent of pre-war levels in September and October.

stories.headline: India U-19 vs Afghanistan U-19, LIVE streaming info: When, where to watch Under-19 Asia Cup semifinal?
stories.text: India Under-19 and Afghanistan Under-19 are competing for a spot in the summit clash of the ACC Under-19 Asia Cup at the Al-Amerat cricket ground in Muscat, Oman. India Under-19 started its campaign with a 10-wicket victory against Nepal before losing its second game to Pakistan. India Under-19 secured its passage to the semifinal by defeating the United Arab Emirates in its third match. The India Under-19 versus Afghanistan Under-19 Under-19 Asia Cup semifinal match is scheduled for November 12, Thursday. The semifinal match between India Under-19 and Afghanistan Under-19 is set to begin at 10:30 AM IST, with the toss occurring at 10:00 AM IST. Live streaming for the India Under-19 and Afghanistan Under-19 match in India is available on the Sony LIV app and website.

stories.headline: India gives ports 15 days to report abandoned ships and crew welfare cases
stories.text: India has ordered ports across the country to identify vessels that are abandoned, detained, or immobilised, along with related crew welfare issues. The Directorate General of Maritime Administration has given major ports, minor ports, and state maritime boards a 15-day deadline to submit this information. The directive requires authorities to report details on vessel owners, operators, managers, agents, crew counts, and welfare problems. This reporting obligation also applies to ships that are under arrest, laid up, stranded, or unable to operate safely, regardless of formal abandonment status. Ports are required to immediately report any new cases that pose risks to life or safety. Authorities that have no qualifying vessels within their jurisdiction are still required to submit a return confirming that status.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang affair in D.C.: Resignation calls and moves to tighten Nvidia China exports
stories.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang admitted on Sunday to having an affair with a woman reported by news outlets to be a Chinese spy. Senate banking committee member Kevin Cramer called on Jensen Huang to resign on Wednesday during an interview with CNBC. A trio of House lawmakers requested Jensen Huang to testify before their committees on Nov. 18. Republican Representatives Brian Mast and John Moolenaar stated on Wednesday afternoon that they were giving Jensen Huang until the end of the day to respond to the testimony request. Representative Suhas Subramanyam stated that Jensen Huang should resign from Nvidia. Congress is attempting to pass bills in the National Defense Authorization Act to tighten export controls on advanced AI chips, including the AI Overwatch Act, the MATCH Act, and the Chip Security Act.

stories.headline: UK Ministry of Defence Recommends Lockheed Martin Over Airbus for £2.4B Skynet Contract
stories.text: On Nov. 5, reports showed the UK Ministry of Defence recommended selecting Lockheed Martin over Airbus for the £2.4 billion Skynet military communications satellite program. UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham will review the recommendation and make a final decision within two weeks. The award covers the Skynet Wideband Satellite System to provide high-capacity military satellite communications for British forces and allies. Airbus warned that losing the contract could result in the elimination of up to 3,000 UK jobs at its Stevenage and Portsmouth manufacturing sites. Lockheed Martin pledged to build a new UK-based manufacturing facility to construct the next-generation satellites domestically. Airbus previously secured the contract for the Skynet 6A satellite in 2020 and constructed the operational Skynet 5 constellation.

stories.headline: Nvidia hires leading US law firm to investigate Jensen Huang’s relationship
stories.text: Nvidia appointed the US law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to investigate the relationship between Chief Executive Jensen Huang and an alleged Chinese spy. Jensen Huang will continue to lead Nvidia without interruption during the investigation overseen by a committee of independent board directors. Jensen Huang admitted on Sunday that he had been unfaithful to his wife after reports surfaced regarding an affair with an alleged Chinese spy who was an Nvidia customer. Nvidia shares fell by more than 8% in extended trading following reports that Jensen Huang had another affair with an executive reporting to him. Nvidia shares closed up 2.9% to $173.73 on Wednesday prior to the admission of marital infidelity. Tech analyst Dan Ives estimated a 15% chance that Jensen Huang is removed as Nvidia CEO and noted the investigation could take four to six weeks.

stories.headline: ‘The only way to get this done’: Why the US wants Europe at Ukraine talks next time
stories.text: Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff planned to visit Moscow on Thursday to meet with Russian President Vladimir Putin following peace talks in Abu Dhabi. Jared Kushner stated that a planned prisoner exchange between Russia and Ukraine would be the biggest humanitarian release of prisoners in the war so far. Jared Kushner stated that his goal during the Moscow visit was to obtain Vladimir Putin's blessing for European officials to join the next round of negotiations. US negotiators Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff plan to travel to Dublin after Moscow to meet with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy in person. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that he wants Europe to decide on a single representative to speak on its behalf by the end of this month. Representatives of the European Commission, the European Council, NATO, the UK, France, Germany, and Italy attended the Abu Dhabi talks on the sidelines.

stories.headline: UK Regulator Gives Unilever and McCormick Until Nov. 18 to Fix Competition Concerns or Face Deeper Probe into $65 Billion Food Merger
stories.text: The Competition and Markets Authority gave Unilever and McCormick a deadline of November 18 to propose remedies for their $65 billion food combination or face a second-phase investigation. The Competition and Markets Authority concluded that mustard is not a concern because English, French and American-style mustard are distinct product markets. Unilever decided in August to put Colman's up for sale to get ahead of potential antitrust objections. McCormick shares fell 2.1% in London trading following the announcement, while Unilever shares were little changed. Unilever announced in March that it would fold its food operations into McCormick to build a company valued at roughly $65 billion. The transaction received approval under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act on October 5, according to Federal Trade Commission records.

stories.headline: Large cap funds regain favour as mid & small cap flows cool
stories.text: Saugata Chatterjee, President and Deputy CEO, Nippon India Mutual Fund, stated that large-cap inflows improved as valuations became relatively attractive. Inflows into large-and-mid-cap funds nearly doubled to ₹8,484 crore in October from ₹4,271 crore a month earlier. Large-cap funds attracted ₹1,032 crore in October, marking a 20 per cent increase from ₹859 crore in the prior period. Inflows into small-cap funds declined by 29 per cent to reach ₹6,407 crore, while mid-cap funds fell by 36 per cent to ₹4,980 crore. Systematic Investment Plan contributions remained resilient at ₹32,160 crore in October compared with ₹32,490 crore in September. The mutual fund industry assets under management increased marginally to ₹83.39 lakh crore in October compared with ₹82.64 lakh crore in September.

stories.headline: Brazil Crop Protection Industry Splits Over Tariff Push
stories.text: Brazil's crop protection sector is divided over a proposal to increase import tariffs on formulated pesticides from zero to 35 percent. Sindiveg filed a request with Brazil's Foreign Trade Chamber in October asking to raise the import tax on formulated herbicides, fungicides and insecticides. Tecnomyl Brasil announced it will leave Sindiveg starting next year due to disagreements regarding the tariff push. On November 6, the Ministry of Agriculture's thematic committee advised on farm input policy voted to send a position opposing the tariff increase to Camex. Aenda asked Camex to reduce the import tax on formulated insecticides sold in packaging up to 7.5 kilograms from 7.2 percent to zero. The competing proposals were reviewed by Camex's Tariff Alteration Committee on November 10.

stories.headline: Government bars export of lithium-ion battery waste and scrap containing black mass
stories.text: The Directorate General of Foreign Trade barred the export of lithium-ion battery waste, scrap, and black mass on November 11, 2026. The Union Ministry of Commerce and Industry stated the decision ensures domestic recycling and refining of black mass generated in India. The Material Recycling Association of India welcomed the amendment as a step towards strengthening India's resource security and circular economy. Industry estimates indicate annual generation of about 30,000 tonnes of black mass from approximately 70,000 tonnes of end-of-life batteries. Global Trade Research Initiative founder Ajay Srivastava noted the measure bars export of items categorised under nomenclature ITC (HS) 85491400. Ajay Srivastava stated that India recorded zero exports worldwide under the relevant trade code in FY2026.

stories.headline: Axalta and AkzoNobel Address UK Merger Concerns
stories.text: Axalta Coating Systems and AkzoNobel are addressing regulatory concerns raised by the Competition and Markets Authority regarding vehicle refinish coatings. Axalta Coating Systems and AkzoNobel propose to divest AkzoNobel's European vehicle refinish coatings business, including UK operations, to resolve regulator issues. Axalta Coating Systems and AkzoNobel intend to use the same divestment package agreed with the European Commission to address UK concerns. Axalta Coating Systems and AkzoNobel remain confident of completing the merger by early 2027. The combined business resulting from the merger is expected to generate approximately US$17 billion in revenue. Shareholders of Axalta Coating Systems and AkzoNobel approved all transaction-related resolutions on August 5, 2026.

stories.headline: Protean eGov shares surge 7.4% as Yubi partnership boosts sentiment
stories.text: Protean eGov Technologies Limited shares rose 7.44 per cent on the National Stock Exchange on Wednesday following a partnership announcement with Yubi Group. The stock of Protean eGov Technologies Limited closed at ₹719.65 after touching an intraday high of ₹727.00. Traded volume for Protean eGov Technologies Limited reached 14.42 lakh shares with a total traded value of ₹102.56 crore. The partnership addresses a formal MSME credit gap of over ₹60 lakh crore and low credit penetration where 28 per cent of Indian adults aged 18-60 are credit-active. Yubi Group has facilitated over ₹3.2 lakh crore in credit to date while Protean eGov Technologies Limited operates India digital public infrastructure including PAN and NPS systems. The stock of Protean eGov Technologies Limited is down 14.59 per cent over the past year with a market capitalisation of approximately ₹2,934.67 crore.

stories.headline: Stand-Up India scheme extended till 2031 to support 2.5 lakh new entrepreneurs
stories.text: The Union Cabinet approved the continuation of the Stand-Up India Scheme for another five years. The Stand-Up India Scheme has been extended until March 31, 2031. The extension includes a credit guarantee corpus of Rs 4,111 crore and aims to support at least 2.5 lakh additional entrepreneurs. The guarantee covers 85 per cent of the loan amount to reduce risk for lending institutions. Eligible entrepreneurs can access loans ranging from above Rs 10 lakh up to Rs 1 crore for new businesses. The Stand-Up India Scheme was originally launched in April 2016.

stories.headline: American soldier arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia
stories.text: London's Metropolitan Police announced on Tuesday evening that a senior soldier in the U.S. Army was arrested in the U.K. on suspicion of spying for Russia. The unnamed 41-year-old man was arrested near Gloucester on Tuesday by the U.K.'s Counter Terrorism Policing alongside U.S. authorities. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov stated on Wednesday that Moscow had absolutely nothing to do with the U.K. case. The detained individual is suspected of committing offenses under Sections 1 and 3 of the U.U.K.'s National Security Act. FBI Director Kash Patel said in a statement on Tuesday evening that the allegations were of the utmost concern to the United States and allies. Sean Stinchon, the commanding general of U.S. Army Counterintelligence Command, stated that insider threats are real and persistent.

stories.headline: UK-based Tide plans to invest ₹3,100 crore in India in next four years
stories.text: UK-based business financial platform Tide plans to invest approximately 250 million pounds, or around ₹3,100 crore, in India by the end of 2030. Tide employs around 800 people at its centre of excellence in Hyderabad across member support, product, and engineering functions. Tide concluded that its India member-facing business lacked a viable path to sustainable profitability despite growing to over one million members since December 2022. The decision to wind down Tide's India member-facing business will impact around 400 employees. Tide Chief Executive Officer Oliver Prill stated that India remains an integral part of the company's global business and long-term growth plans. Tide anticipates its annualised revenue run rate will surpass USD 500 million in the coming months.

stories.headline: India eyes wind turbine upgrades to boost output, overcome land hurdles
stories.text: India is considering replacing older, smaller wind turbines with larger, more efficient machines to increase power generation without acquiring extra land. Aditya Pyasi, Chief Executive Officer of the Indian Wind Turbine Manufacturers Association, stated that up to 8 gigawatts of capacity from old turbines can be upgraded. The lobby group is discussing a plan with federal and state governments that could increase capacity at those specific sites by nearly 50%. Wind installations in India have lagged significantly behind solar power due to challenges in land acquisition and securing right-of-way. Replacing older turbines under 2 megawatts with modern 3- to 5-megawatt units at existing locations can help bypass land-access barriers. The Indian Wind Turbine Manufacturers Association is collaborating with windy states including Gujarat, Maharashtra and Karnataka to solidify an implementation plan.

stories.headline: Interarch Building Solutions' (NSE:INTERARCH) Solid Earnings May Rest On Weak Foundations
stories.text: Interarch Building Solutions recorded an accrual ratio of 0.36 for the year to September 2026. Interarch Building Solutions reported a profit of ₹1.33b for the period. Interarch Building Solutions burnt through ₹1.3b in free cash flow in the last year. Interarch Building Solutions also had negative free cash flow and an outflow of ₹1.3b in the previous year. Interarch Building Solutions achieved a 40% per annum growth in EPS for the last three years. Aimtron Electronics Limited's stock performed strongly following the release of its earnings report. Over the twelve months leading to September 2026, Aimtron Electronics recorded an accrual ratio of 0.24. Aimtron Electronics reported a profit of ₹604.8m over the last twelve months. Aimtron Electronics experienced a negative free cash flow with an outflow of ₹1.2m in the last twelve months. Aimtron Electronics also recorded negative free cash flow in the preceding year.

stories.headline: U.S. CPI Fuels Talk of Half-Point Fed Hike as Treasury Yields Spike
stories.text: U.S. Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller stated that the central bank should weigh a 0.50 percentage point rate increase at the December meeting if October core consumer price index growth hit approximately 0.3% or higher. All eight domestically listed KOSPI 200 covered-call exchange-traded funds lowered their October payouts by an average of 15.3% compared to the previous month. Korean retail investors sold $500.37 million of Tesla stock over the past month while net purchasing $608.41 million in SpaceX. Anthropic scheduled its Nasdaq listing for the 19th and filed an amended registration statement introducing a phased lockup allowing certain shareholders to sell shares immediately after listing.

stories.headline: India bonds to stay hemmed in by oil, Treasury moves ahead of inflation data
stories.text: Indian government bonds are expected to trade within a range influenced by softer oil prices and rising US yields. Market participants are awaiting domestic inflation data that might impact the rate strategy of the Reserve Bank of India. A Reuters poll projects a rise in annual consumer inflation which could prompt the Reserve Bank of India to undertake further tightening. Investors are exercising caution prior to a major bond auction planned for Friday.

stories.headline: The 2-Year Treasury Yield Just Had Its Biggest Jump in 19 Months
stories.text: Federal Reserve governor Christopher Waller stated in London that a 50 basis point hike should be considered if October core CPI hit 0.3% or higher. October core CPI rose 0.3% for a third straight month, coming in above expectations of 0.2%. The iShares 1-3 Year Treasury Bond ETF fell 0.33% to $81.32, and the iShares 20+ Year Treasury Bond ETF fell 1.32% to $80.88. The 1-year Treasury yield rose 18 basis points to 4.56%, and the 10-year Treasury yield rose 10 basis points to 4.98%.

stories.headline: Crude Falls 1% as Iran, Ukraine Talks Ease Supply Fears
stories.text: Crude oil prices declined more than 1% on Thursday, November 12, due to diplomatic progress regarding the Iran and Russia-Ukraine wars. Russian and Ukrainian negotiators agreed to a major prisoner exchange after two days of US-mediated discussions in Abu Dhabi.

stories.headline: Crude oil faces a geopolitical test as Russia signals progress toward peace
stories.text: Vladimir Medinsky stated that Russia and Ukraine are moving closer to peace, following talks in Abu Dhabi where they agreed to a large-scale prisoner exchange and found common ground on some issues. Crude oil reached $87.56 and briefly moved above the 100 day moving average before diplomatic headlines sent the price back toward $87.00.

stories.headline: IndiGo shares surge past analyst target as falling crude, Q2 beat draw buyers
stories.text: InterGlobe Aviation passenger yields jumped 34.3 per cent to ₹6.30 per km in Q2FY27. InterGlobe Aviation EBITDA fell roughly 6.7 per cent to ₹32.4bn in Q2FY27 as fuel costs surged about 67.2 per cent year-on-year.

stories.headline: Market News Today Australia: Hot US CPI Sends Treasury Yields Near 5%, Gold Falls as Stocks Slide
stories.text: The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield briefly exceeded 5% following the inflation data release. Gold prices fell approximately 2.6% during the market session to around US$4,032 per ounce.

stories.headline: Buy Kalyan Jewellers India: target of Rs 800: ICICI Securities
stories.text: ICICI Securities recommends a buy rating for Kalyan Jewellers India with a revised target price of INR 800. Kalyan Jewellers India reported year-on-year growth of approximately 31% in revenue, 30% in EBITDA, and 64% in PAT for Q2FY27. The gross margin of Kalyan Jewellers India contracted by 61 basis points year-on-year to 12.3% in Q2FY27. ICICI Securities raised its EPS estimates for Kalyan Jewellers India for FY27 and FY28 by 0.6% and 3.1% respectively. ICICI Securities models revenue, EBITDA, and adjusted PAT CAGRs of 24.4%, 21.6%, and 30.6% respectively over FY26 to FY28E for Kalyan Jewellers India.

stories.headline: AIT Worldwide Logistics Expands into Oceania with Acquisition of Australia-Based Connor Anderson International
stories.text: AIT Worldwide Logistics agreed to acquire Sydney-based Connor Anderson International to expand its presence in Australia and Oceania. Connor Anderson International was founded in 1974 and offers sea, air and road freight transportation, customs brokerage, warehousing and project cargo management. Connor Anderson International operates offices and warehouse facilities in Sydney and Melbourne. Ray Fennelly, Chief Development Officer at AIT Worldwide Logistics, stated that the acquisition serves as the foundation for long-term expansion in Oceania. Theo Pambris, Director at Connor Anderson International, stated that joining global networks will offer customers broader capabilities and worldwide support.

stories.headline: SBI shares gain 1%, among top Nifty gainers, as brokerages bullish on loan growth, profitability outlook
stories.text: State Bank of India shares rose around 1 percent on Thursday, making the lender one of the top Nifty 50 gainers after brokerages CLSA and Goldman Sachs maintained a bullish outlook. State Bank of India shares traded around Rs 1,072 in morning deals, bringing the bank's market capitalisation to approximately Rs 9.9 lakh crore. State Bank of India has retained its loan growth guidance at 14 to 15 percent, with retail, agriculture and MSME loans forming 65 percent of the domestic loan portfolio. State Bank of India management reiterated its goal to reach a core return on assets of 1 percent across the business cycle. State Bank of India management noted that corporate capital expenditure is starting to appear in sectors including thermal power, renewable energy and roads.

stories.headline: Sensex up 350 pts, Nifty near 25,350: Persistent FII buying among key factors behind market rise
stories.text: The Sensex increased by 346.18 points or 0.42 percent to trade at 82,225.58 on Thursday. The Nifty advanced by 90.85 points or 0.36 percent to reach 25,345.90 on Thursday. The Nifty Smallcap 100 and Nifty Midcap 100 indices rose by 1.34 percent and 0.92 percent respectively. V K Vijayakumar stated that the Nifty's 9.55 percent rally in November was driven primarily by foreign institutional investors. Brent crude traded 1.12 percent lower at USD 91.75 per barrel.

stories.headline: Accumulate Dabur India; target of Rs 450: Prabhudas Lilladher
stories.text: Dabur India outlined a growth acceleration strategy named Ignite focusing on core brands, premium products, execution, savings, and acquisitions. Dabur India aims to increase the share of premium products from 17% to 20% within 18 months. Dabur India plans to fund growth by increasing savings from Rs 1.15 bn to Rs 2 bn. Dabur India reiterated its full-year double-digit revenue growth guidance driven by momentum across core brands and other segments. Prabhudas Lilladher estimated a Sales and EPS CAGR of 10% and 11.9% respectively for Dabur India over FY27–29.

stories.headline: Poland turns to home-grown giant for its defense buildup
stories.text: Poland aims to spend 200 billion złoty, equivalent to 4.8% of GDP, on defense this year, making it the highest level in the NATO alliance. Poland is the largest recipient of the European Union's 150 billion euro SAFE loans-for-arms program, securing almost 44 billion euro. Polish Armaments Group CEO Adam Leszkiewicz stated that the state-owned conglomerate manufactures more than 700 products. State-owned Polish Armaments Group reported 18.4 billion złoty in revenues for 2025, marking a 23% increase compared to the previous year. Polish Armaments Group recorded 2.8 billion złoty in profit for 2025, representing a 66% increase from the prior year.

stories.headline: HSBC explores bolstering Singapore to balance China reliance
stories.text: HSBC Holdings has explored ways to reduce its reliance on China including Hong Kong and grant more independence to its Singapore operations. HSBC Holdings generated about 40% of its pretax profit in the first half from Hong Kong. HSBC Holdings shares fell as much as 0.8% in early Hong Kong trading. Hong Kong generated US$7.8 billion of pretax profits in the first half of 2026, which was about 40% of the group total. Singapore generated US$774 million of pretax profit in the first half of 2026, which was roughly a 10th of Hong Kong's profit.

stories.headline: France blames Iran for supermarket fridge hacks, seeks EU sanctions
stories.text: France accused Iran of conducting cyberattacks that sabotaged supermarket refrigerators, spoiled food, and caused fires across approximately 700 commercial sites. French investigators identified Shahid Kaveh, a cyber unit linked to Iran’s Revolutionary Guards, as responsible for the attacks. The French Foreign Ministry stated it would summon Iran’s ambassador and propose sanctions against involved Iranian individuals and organisations. French prosecutors requested international arrest warrants for several members of the Shahid Kaveh group. French authorities estimated food losses at tens of millions of euros after at least 15 fires broke out due to the temperature sabotage.

stories.headline: The Kremlin can hide the death toll. It can’t hide the graves.
stories.text: In September 2022, Russian Defense Minister Sergei Shoigu stated that 5,937 Russian soldiers had died in the conflict in Ukraine. The U.K. Foreign Office and Dutch intelligence services estimate Russian military losses to exceed half a million. In July, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy announced that 700,000 Russian soldiers had died fighting in Ukraine. In April 2024, a Kremlin spokesperson stated that casualty information is a state secret. The casualty-tracking database Russia 200 recorded almost 90,000 court cases concerning soldiers declared missing in action or dead in 2025.

stories.headline: Codelco, Adani Group sign agreement for copper exploration project
stories.text: The agreement between Codelco and Adani Group is to develop the Kaburkaala copper exploration project. The Kaburkaala copper exploration project is located in Chile's northern region of Antofagasta. Codelco stated that Adani Group would provide financing for the Kaburkaala copper exploration project. The Kaburkaala copper exploration project could provide long-term supply for Adani Group's smelting complex in Mundra, India. Codelco and Adani Group agreed to a partnership last year and evaluated potential Codelco copper projects.

stories.headline: Trading Plan: Can healthy broader-market structure help Nifty 50 reclaim 25,300 and Bank Nifty regain...
stories.text: On November 11, the Nifty 50 rallied 210 points, or 0.84 percent, to close at 25,255. On November 11, the Bank Nifty surged 1,051 points, or 1.76 percent, to finish at 60,792. On the National Stock Exchange, 2,319 stocks advanced while 1,021 stocks declined during the session. Sudeep Shah from SBI Securities noted that the Nifty 50 RSI has climbed close to 80. Himanshu Gupta from Jainam stated that the Nifty 50 is holding above the previous close of 25,044.65.

stories.headline: ISRAELIRANWAR. Iran: Nuclear power will remain. We are capable of striking even very distant bases, a warning to European countries. USA: Let's entrust Iraq with mediating with Iran. IRGC strikes Didamar Island.
stories.text: The United States House of Representatives voted 211-204 to refer an impeachment resolution against Secretary of War Hegseth to the House Judiciary Committee. Mohsen Rezaei announced that Tehran intends to keep its enriched uranium domestically to design nuclear-powered ships and submarines rather than exporting it. The Gaza Ministry of Health stated that 74,653 Palestinians have been killed and 176,007 injured in Israeli attacks. The Saudi-led coalition stated it intercepted three Yemeni cruise missiles in the skies over Riyadh. The UK Maritime Trade Operations agency reported an oil tanker was struck by a shell roughly 19 nautical miles northeast of Lima, Oman, with no reported casualties.

stories.headline: Is Somnigroup International (SGI) Cheap On Earnings, Dividends And Acquisition Plans?
stories.text: Somnigroup International shares fell 10.49% over the past week and dropped 29.58% year to date. Somnigroup International achieved a 3-year total shareholder return of 58.37% and a 5-year total shareholder return of 48.34%. The analyst consensus Narrative on Simply Wall St calculates a fair value of $93.44 against Somnigroup International's last close at $62.49. Analyst consensus models Somnigroup International earnings expanding from $533.3 million today to $1.1 billion by 2029. Analysts model Somnigroup International profit margins at 9.4% in three years compared with 7.0% now.

stories.headline: Trump’s Iran war pause is as costly as new strikes
stories.text: Benchmark Brent crude fell below US$90 a barrel on Tuesday for the first time since late August. US President Donald Trump said on Monday that he would hold off on new military action against Iran. Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has averaged 10.5 million barrels per day since the start of October. Total average Gulf crude exports have risen to 16.7 million barrels per day since the start of October. Freight and insurance costs remain about 10 times pre-war levels.

stories.headline: Hong Kong set for more diverse IPOs as global funds seek Chinese world-beaters: Citigroup
stories.text: Citigroup stated that the Hong Kong stock market initial public offering pipeline will become more diverse in 2027. Global investors will show greater appetite for solid Chinese companies in biotechnology, advanced manufacturing, and renewable energy, according to Citigroup. International institutions remain keen to allocate a large portion of their assets to China's world-beaters upon their Hong Kong listings, according to Simon Yuan. Simon Yuan is the head of China investment banking at Citigroup. Biotech and biomedical sectors experienced a relatively quiet year in contrast to high funding activities last year, according to Citigroup observations.

stories.headline: Exide, Amara Raja rush to monetize $1 billion Li-ion cell lines as investor questions mount
stories.text: Exide Industries and Amara Raja Energy & Mobility are rushing to operationalize lithium-ion cell lines due to investor pressure over returns on more than $1 billion in investments.
