Exide Industries has invested $632 million, while Amara Raja Energy & Mobility has deployed $248 million and approved an additional $247 million this month. Exide Industries is starting initial revenue generation with lithium iron phosphate cells for e-rickshaws and telecom towers, whereas Amara Raja Energy & Mobility is focusing on battery energy storage system projects. Amara Raja Energy & Mobility shares declined 18% so far this year, Exide Industries shares increased 6%, and the Nifty Auto index rose 0.15% over the same period. Amara Raja Energy & Mobility planned to start commercial operations in battery energy storage systems before its electric vehicle cell business begins.

stories.headline: Out-of-the-box Hyderabad: Strengthening India’s aerospace capabilities
stories.text: Telangana is preparing to introduce its Aerospace and Defence Policy 2.0 to become India's leading defence manufacturing hub. General Manoj Mukund Naravane recently remarked that India needs to scale up drone production to nearly 40,000 units a month. Achieving a monthly production of 40,000 drones would result in an annual production of approximately 4.8 lakh units. Over the next four to five years, AKSI Aerospace Group plans to expand indigenous subsystem manufacturing, including flight controllers, autopilots, smart batteries, composites, propulsion, and precision engineering. AKSI Aerospace Group has set an ambition to be positioned among India's recognised aerospace technology groups by the year 2030.

stories.headline: We Think That There Are Issues Underlying HP Telecom India's (NSE:HPTL) Earnings
stories.text: HP Telecom India reported a robust earnings report, but shareholders may have noticed concerning underlying factors that kept the stock market unmoved. For the year leading up to September 2026, HP Telecom India recorded an accrual ratio of 0.85. HP Telecom India did not generate free cash flow for the year ending September 2026 and instead burnt through ₹712m. HP Telecom India reported a profit of ₹439.5m for the year. HP Telecom India's earnings per share experienced an extremely impressive growth rate over the last three years.

stories.headline: How one of Beijing’s most luxurious hotels is becoming a premium retirement home
stories.text: Ping An Life Insurance is redeveloping the Legendale Hotel Beijing into a high-end living complex for retirees. Legendale Hotel Beijing has closed to guests to be converted into an ultra-premium nursing home. Admission to the converted nursing home requires an insurance premium exceeding 18.88 million yuan. The Beijing Dongcheng district housing authority disclosed bringing Ping An Life Insurance on board for the redevelopment. The hotel is located near the Forbidden City and Peking Union Medical College Hospital.

stories.headline: Rare earth yttrium soars 9-fold in a year amid China curbs
stories.text: Prices for the heavy rare-earth metal yttrium have skyrocketed nine-fold in the past year due to Chinese export curbs. China has clamped down on exports of yttrium, raising concern among Japanese companies. Japanese companies are concerned about depleting inventories and future supply of yttrium. Japan is seeking alternative sources for yttrium, which is used in chipmaking and jet engines. Yttrium is a heavy rare-earth element used in defense applications and semiconductor manufacturing.

stories.headline: Nvidia shares recover 4.5% after steep sell-off; China spy probe and November 17 earnings to test investor confidence
stories.text: Nvidia shares rebounded nearly 4.5% in Wednesday's trade to reach an intraday high of $176.23 following solid results from CoreWeave. Nvidia board members launched an investigation into Jensen Huang and a woman suspected by US intelligence of working for Chinese intelligence regarding shipments of export-restricted chips. Nvidia shares have dropped 29% since hitting a record high on October 6, reducing the market capitalisation to around $4 trillion from $5.8 trillion a month ago. Alphabet Inc., Meta Platforms Inc. and Amazon.com Inc. account for approximately 23% of Nvidia's revenue according to Bloomberg supply-chain data. Nvidia scheduled its quarterly earnings announcement for November 17, 2026.

stories.headline: Dixon Technologies sells half its stake in CP Plus parent Aditya Infotech for Rs 582 crore
stories.text: Dixon Technologies sold half of its equity stake in Aditya Infotech through open market transactions on November 11. Dixon Technologies sold 14.04 lakh equity shares, which represented a 1.14% stake in Aditya Infotech, for Rs 581.65 crore. Dixon Technologies divested the 1.14% stake at Rs 4,140 per share. Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund acquired 8.42 lakh shares of Aditya Infotech, representing a 0.69% stake, for Rs 348.99 crore. Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund purchased 5.61 lakh shares of Aditya Infotech, representing a 0.45% stake, for Rs 232.66 crore.

stories.headline: Nutrifresh plans 150-acre expansion across South India
stories.text: Nutrifresh is expanding its operations in South India with a goal to reach around 150 acres of cultivation footprint across Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Chennai by March 2028. Nutrifresh expects to reach a total South India footprint of 50 acres by the end of the current financial year. Nutrifresh plans to invest approximately ₹50–75 crore from the company's side to develop infrastructure across South India. Nutrifresh expects the overall investment, including contributions from farmer partners, to be ₹200–225 crore. Nutrifresh clocked revenues of ₹219.3 crore in FY26 and is targeting ₹400 crore in FY27.

stories.headline: Nifty 50 target: Index in sweet spot? 28,000 soon? HSBC, Citi and Bernstein raise targets after sharp 13.5% recovery
stories.text: The Nifty 50 recovered 13.5% from war-induced lows, reducing its year-to-date losses to 3.35%. Foreign portfolio investors pumped ₹53,739 crore into domestic stocks in November according to National Securities Depository Limited data. Citigroup raised its Nifty 50 target to 28,000 from 26,000 and expects corporate earnings to grow at a CAGR of 15-16% over FY26-FY28. HSBC Holdings Plc upgraded Indian equities to overweight from neutral citing resilient earnings and reasonable valuations. Bernstein raised its Nifty 50 target to 26,100 from 25,000 and maintained a near-term Trading Buy rating.

stories.headline: Zelenskyy warns Ukraine is 'not real estate' as experts say a Russia peace deal remains elusive
stories.text: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that his country was not real estate during peace talks. The peace talks involving Russian and Ukrainian representatives took place in Abu Dhabi and were mediated by U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner. Vladimir Medinsky announced that the parties reached an agreement on a large-scale prisoner exchange. Mykola Bielieskov stated that Ukraine could potentially accept a ceasefire along current front lines. William Courtney stated that the Trump administration is no longer attempting to achieve a ceasefire due to Russian objections.

stories.headline: Broker’s Call: Data Patterns India (Buy)
stories.text: Data Patterns India reported a weak Q2 performance with revenue, EBITDA, and PAT declining by 56.7 per cent, 54.2 per cent, and 55.6 per cent year on year. Data Patterns India saw its revenue improve by 14.8 per cent quarter on quarter in Q2. Data Patterns India recorded an EBITDAM of 23.5 per cent, which contracted by 350 basis points on quarter due to uneven execution of large defence programmes. Data Patterns India holds a firm order-book of ₹1,724 crore and negotiated orders of ₹956 crore, bringing total order visibility to ₹2,680 crore. Data Patterns India acquired ST Advanced Composites to strengthen its in-house capabilities and support its integrated-system offering.

stories.headline: SFO Technologies, Cochin Shipyard unveil India’s first indigenous laser arc welding technology
stories.text: SFO Technologies and Cochin Shipyard unveiled India's first indigenously designed and manufactured Hybrid Laser Arc Welding technology. The Advanced Laser Engineering Centre and Hybrid Laser Arc Welding R&D Facility was inaugurated at NeST Hitek Park in Kalamassery. Cochin Shipyard Chairman and Managing Director Jose V. J. and SFO Technologies Chairman and Managing Director N. Jehangir inaugurated the facility. The Hybrid Laser Arc Welding system integrates laser welding, conventional arc welding, robotics, and advanced automation powered by an in-house high-power fibre laser source. The new facility will focus on research, testing, validation, and commercialisation of advanced laser technologies to support Atmanirbhar Bharat.

stories.headline: Bernstein sees further upside for Nifty by December despite 11% surge in 12 sessions; check target
stories.text: The Nifty index rose by over 11 percent across 12 trading sessions following its October 28 low of 22,497 points. Brokerage firm Bernstein increased its December target for the Nifty 50 index to 26,100 points from 25,000 points. Bernstein analysts Venugopal Garre and Nikhil Arela attributed market momentum to easing geopolitical concerns and Donald Trump's statement regarding Iran. Citi raised its end-2027 Nifty target to 28,000 points, while HSBC upgraded its rating on Indian equities to 'Overweight' from 'Neutral'. Brent crude futures traded around USD 93 per barrel after dropping to a two-month low of USD 89.16 previously.

stories.headline: India ranked an AI Rising Contender by BCG, built on talent rather than compute
stories.text: Boston Consulting Group ranked India as a Rising Contender in artificial intelligence in its AI Maturity Matrix 2026 report. Boston Consulting Group stated that India's position is primarily built on skills, including a large pool of artificial intelligence specialists. Boston Consulting Group noted that cross-border relocation of artificial intelligence talent declined 12 per cent in 2025. The Indian government launched the Yuva AI for ALL free foundational course to upskill 10 million citizens. Boston Consulting Group reported that enterprise artificial intelligence investment doubled in 2026 compared to the previous year as a share of firm revenue.

stories.headline: Argentina, Malaysia overtake Indonesia as top veg oil exporters to India
stories.text: In the marketing year 2025-26, Argentina and Malaysia surpassed Indonesia to become the top vegetable oil exporters to India according to the US Department of Agriculture. Data from the Solvent Extractors’ Association of India showed India imported 3.42 million tonnes of edible oils from Argentina between November 2025 and September 2026. During the same period, imports from Malaysia stood at 2.97 million tonnes and from Indonesia at 2.90 million tonnes. The US Department of Agriculture stated that total palm oil imports reached 8.4 million tonnes, soybean oil reached 5 million tonnes, and sunflower oil reached 3.85 million tonnes. Sudhakar Desai of the Indian Vegetable Oil Producers’ Association noted that Indonesia's trade with India has declined since 2022-23 due to biodiesel blending mandates raising domestic consumption.

stories.headline: Technical View: Bulls remain in control, but Nifty 50 faces consolidation and profit-booking risks below...
stories.text: The Nifty 50 gained eight-tenths of a percent to reach a fresh eight-and-a-half-month high on November 11 driven by persistent FII buying and easing oil prices. The Nifty 50 settled up 210 points or 0.84 percent at 25,255 after touching an intraday high of 25,424 on Wednesday. HDFC Securities Senior Technical Research Analyst Nagaraj Shetti stated that strong overhead resistance exists around the 25,400–25,500 levels. The 25,500 and 25,400 strikes feature maximum Call open interest acting as immediate resistance for the Nifty 50. The India VIX increased by 0.77 percent to reach 17.55 according to market data.

stories.headline: Alok Rajput: GM, Technology & Data Centre Business Development, Vertiv India
stories.text: Alok Rajput serves as the general manager of technology and data centre business development at Vertiv India. Alok Rajput brings over 26 years of experience spanning critical infrastructure, precision cooling, and data centre thermal management. Alok Rajput states that artificial intelligence compute density is pushing conventional air-cooling architectures to their limits. Alok Rajput earned a BTech in production engineering and management from the National Institute of Technology, Calicut. Alok Rajput obtained an MBA in finance from Sikkim Manipal University.

stories.headline: Sensex today | Stock Market Highlights: Sensex closes 772 pts higher, Nifty ends above 25,250; M&M, IndiGo top gainers
stories.text: At the interbank foreign exchange market, the Indian rupee opened at 93.71 against the US dollar on November 11, 2026. Patna Municipal Corporation listed its maiden municipal bond on the National Stock Exchange of India on November 10, 2026. Sagar Defence Engineering Limited raised ₹300 crore from Indian institutional investors as part of its pre-IPO fundraising. India's equity-oriented mutual funds recorded net inflows of INR 32,994 crore in October 2026. India's industry assets under management recovered to ₹83.38 lakh crore as on October 31, 2026.

stories.headline: India, Canada discuss advancing negotiations for proposed trade pact
stories.text: India and Canada held discussions on November 11, 2026, to advance negotiations for a proposed free trade agreement. The talks were conducted between Indian Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal and Canadian Minister of International Trade Maninder Sidhu. Maninder Sidhu led an accompanying Canadian delegation during the meeting in India. Piyush Goyal stated that both sides discussed advancing negotiations on the India-Canada Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement. Both ministers exchanged views on securing a balanced and mutually beneficial agreement to provide meaningful market access and new trade opportunities.

stories.headline: Moody's ups India's FY27 growth forecast to 7% on strong economic momentum, warns of risks
stories.text: Moody's Ratings raised India's economic growth forecast for 2026-27 to 7% from 6.5%. Moody's Ratings released its Global Macro Outlook 2027-28 on Wednesday. Moody's Ratings stated that retail inflation is close to the upper end of the Reserve Bank of India's 2-6% target range. Moody's Ratings warned that a deficient southwest monsoon and strengthening El Nino conditions could hurt agricultural output and rural demand. Moody's Ratings noted that India managed the energy price shock better than initially expected by diversifying crude oil and gas supplies.

stories.headline: Equity MF investments drop 14% to ₹33,000 crore on market volatility
stories.text: Equity mutual fund investments dropped by nearly 14 per cent to ₹32,994 crore in October compared to September's inflow of ₹38,306 crore, according to the Association of Mutual Funds of India. Systematic Investment Plans experienced a marginal decline in monthly inflows to ₹32,160 crore in October from ₹32,490 crore in September. The number of contributing Systematic Investment Plan accounts declined to 10 crore in October from 10.06 crore in September. Both gold and silver exchange-traded funds recorded inflows of over ₹3,000 crore each during October. A total of 28 new fund offerings across all categories were launched in October, garnering ₹3,829 crore of funds according to Association of Mutual Funds of India data.

stories.headline: Stock markets hit eight-month high as foreign investors return
stories.text: Indian stock market benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty jumped over 1% on November 11, 2026, reaching an eight-month high. Foreign portfolio investors bought $5.68 billion of Indian shares in November 2026. Jefferies stated in a report on November 11, 2026, that lower oil prices, a moderated AI trade, and resilient domestic demand could drive durable foreign inflows. Brent crude futures fell to a two-month low of $89.16 per barrel on November 10, 2026. Blackstone agreed to acquire an approximately 16% stake in IIFL Finance.

stories.headline: Trump could be about to sell out Ukraine. Europe must get its act together, fast | Paul Taylor
stories.text: Donald Trump is reportedly considering a deal with Moscow that could grant Vladimir Putin a slice of Ukrainian territory and sanctions relief. Three-way negotiations involving the US, Russia, and Ukraine are taking place in Abu Dhabi, with European nations relegated to a side room. Donald Trump has accepted the principle of a meeting with Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of an Asia-Pacific summit in Shenzhen on 18-19 November. Elon Musk is reportedly hobbling Ukraine's drone defense by imposing speed limits on his Starshield satellite network. Belgian prime minister Bart de Wever has refused to allow impounded Russian funds to be used to support Ukraine.

stories.headline: Earnings Troubles May Signal Larger Issues for Torrent Power (NSE:TORNTPOWER) Shareholders
stories.text: Torrent Power Limited recorded an accrual ratio of 0.21 for the year leading up to September 2026. Torrent Power Limited reported a negative free cash flow with an outflow of ₹49b over the last twelve months. Torrent Power Limited achieved a profit of ₹24.2b in the last twelve months. Torrent Power Limited's earnings per share have experienced a growth rate of 6.0% over the last three years. Asian Star Company Limited recently reported a weak earnings report that did not cause a big stock movement. Asian Star Company Limited's profit results included a ₹75m gain attributed to unusual items. Asian Star Company Limited saw its earnings per share decline over the last twelve months. An analysis of Asian Star Company Limited identified 3 warning signs that deserve attention.

stories.headline: Inflation jitters throw a wrench into US Treasury auction as Fed official flags jumbo hike
stories.text: US Treasury auction for US$42 billion faced inflation concerns that reignited a market rout and supported China's de-dollarisation push. The US$42 billion batch of Treasuries was sold at a yield of 5.02 per cent. The 5.02 per cent yield on the Treasury auction was higher than the previous secondary market yield.

stories.headline: Natural Gas Price Forecast: December NG Breaks $3.24 Toward $3.60 on Record LNG Flows
stories.text: Average flows to the nine major US export terminals reached 19.3 Bcf/d so far in November.

stories.headline: Nifty eyes record as largecaps lead charge on strong corporate earnings
stories.text: Strong Q2 earnings, attractive valuations, and easing crude oil prices are pushing the Sensex and Nifty closer to their record highs.

stories.headline: Gold, silver rebound after CPI-driven selloff, Hormuz tensions lift crude oil - Kitco AM Report
stories.text: Japan's Nikkei 225 advanced approximately 1.3% and China's Shanghai Composite gained around 0.5%.

stories.headline: UK data centre development to ramp up uninhibited by US sector turmoil
stories.text: Search Acumen research shows the number of data centres in the UK is projected to increase by 30% to 785 next year. Search Acumen data indicates the UK had 602 data centres in October, following a 15% growth from 523 facilities in 2025. Nvidia lost $430bn in valuation after chief executive Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with Alice Huang. US president Donald Trump confirmed the FBI is investigating the Nvidia chief executive, while Beijing denied allegations involving Alice Huang. Artificial intelligence chatbot maker Anthropic is targeting a stock market valuation of up to $1.4trn. Weil private equity infrastructure co-head Simon Cardia stated that UK data centre delivery in 2027 will likely remain unaffected by US AI stock sell-offs. Microsoft cancelled plans for a supercomputer at Nscale's facility in Loughton, Essex, last month because of power connection delays. Chancellor John Healey introduced plans for the British Data Centre Covenant during the Autumn Budget to provide priority grid connections.

stories.headline: Analysis: Is Nvidia too big to fail? Its AI financing web raises the stakes
stories.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang faces allegations involving a woman suspected of spying for China, with scrutiny from the FBI, Congress, and the company board. Nvidia stock fell 27 percent from its Oct. 6 peak through Wednesday close, and dropped another 8 percent in after hours trading Wednesday. Nvidia disclosed in July that it committed to buy up to $36 billion in cloud services from smaller AI companies known as neoclouds. Columbia Business School finance professor Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh estimates Nvidia financial obligations at $400 billion overall. The cost of insuring CoreWeave debt rose by 94 percent from Oct. 1 to Nov. 5, according to LSEG data. The price of an IREN convertible bond maturing in 2029 fell 23 percent from Nov. 3 to Nov. 5 amid a 26 percent decline in its share price. AMD, Broadcom, Intel, Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI have efforts underway to build their own AI chips, according to Stijn Van Nieuwerburgh.

stories.headline: Nvidia preparing to replace CEO Jensen Huang as second alleged affair emerges: report
stories.text: Nvidia is preparing to remove Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang following reports of extramarital relationships. The New York Times reported that Jensen Huang had an extramarital relationship with Nvidia vice president of healthcare Kimberly Powell. Jensen Huang admitted on Sunday that he had been unfaithful to his wife in a separate relationship with a woman described as an alleged Chinese spy. Jensen Huang acknowledged falling short of his responsibilities and pledged to cooperate with an independent board investigation. Baird downgraded Nvidia stock to neutral due to uncertainty regarding Jensen Huang's tenure, potential demand softness, and limited 2027 data center spending visibility. Nvidia lost more than $427 billion in market capitalization over the first two trading sessions following the disclosure and board investigation announcement.

stories.headline: Nvidia hires major US law firm to investigate spying claims; UK chancellor ‘dismayed’ by budget leak – as it happened
stories.text: Nvidia has lost approximately $430 billion in market value following a spying scandal involving its leadership. Nvidia retained Joon H. Kim and his law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to conduct an independent investigation. The investigation will examine the relationship between Nvidia chief executive Jensen Huang and Alice Huang, who is suspected by US officials of being a Chinese spy. Beijing has denied the allegations that it operated an espionage operation targeting Jensen Huang. Nvidia shares declined by almost 5.5% yesterday, following a 4.27% drop on Monday. Nvidia market valuation fell to $4.07 trillion from $4.50 trillion prior to the story emerging.

stories.headline: Google DeepMind just mathematically verified key parts of Signal
stories.text: Google DeepMind researchers used agentic AI to mathematically prove key cryptographic guarantees of the Signal protocol. The project was conducted as a proof-of-concept in a duration of just four weeks. The Signal protocol protects communications on platforms such as the Signal app, Google Messages, and WhatsApp. Google DeepMind performed the verification capabilities using a new AI framework named AlphaProof Code. Google DeepMind researchers are releasing the specification and proof they developed for the Signal protocol analysis. Google declined to share the cost of the analysis and whether it plans to release a commercial formal verification product or service.

stories.headline: 5G fixed wireless gives rural India a rare connectivity lead
stories.text: India had 13.61 million 5G fixed wireless access subscribers at the end of September 2026, with 7.06 million in rural areas and 6.54 million in urban areas. TRAI operator data indicates Reliance Jio had 9.52 million 5G FWA subscribers in September, while Bharti Airtel had 4.09 million. Reliance Jio's monthly ARPU reached Rs 218.8 in the September quarter. Bharti Airtel's Homes revenue grew 25.3 percent year on year in the September quarter, adding 676,000 customers to reach 15.4 million.

stories.headline: Stock market outlook today, 12 Nov: Sensex, Nifty prediction - DJIA, S&P, NASDAQ, GIFT Nifty, Kospi, Nikkei, Taiwan cues
stories.text: The Indian stock market is expected to open on a negative note on Thursday, November 12, 2026, as indicated by the GIFT Nifty signalling a muted start for the Sensex and the Nifty 50. The Nasdaq rose nearly 1.6% on Wednesday, November 11, while the S&P 500 advanced as much as 1.3% during the same trading session. The South Korean KOSPI index opened at 5,385.94 on November 12, up 0.2%, though it remained volatile in early trade. Taiwan's Taiex index fell up to 0.75% to 43,923.12 as the Taiwan stock market opened on a muted note on Thursday.

stories.headline: Coral India Finance and Housing (NSE:CORALFINAC) Posted Healthy Earnings But There Are Some Other Factors To Be Aware Of
stories.text: Coral India Finance and Housing Limited experienced a strong stock price following its healthy earnings report. Coral India Finance and Housing Limited recorded an increase in non-operating revenue from ₹42.6m to ₹56.5m over the last year. Coral India Finance and Housing Limited posted a 9.9% increase in its earnings per share in the last year. Coral India Finance and Housing Limited is showing four warning signs in the investment analysis, with one considered unpleasant.

stories.headline: Sensex storms back with fastest 10,000-point gain
stories.text: India's BSE Sensex closed at 81,879.4 points on November 11 after hitting an intra-day high of 82,520.4. The BSE Sensex gained 10,286 points from October 8 to November 11, marking its fastest-ever 10,000-point rally in history. The BSE Sensex achieved the 10,000-point increase in just 23 trading sessions over 34 calendar days. Foreign Institutional Investors purchased ₹ 53,739 crore up to November 9, according to NSDL data accessed through CMIE.

stories.headline: Adani to finance Chile copper project to secure long-term supply for Mundra smelter
stories.text: Chilean state-run copper producer Codelco stated on Wednesday it signed an agreement with India’s Adani Group to develop the Kaburkaala copper exploration project. Adani Group will provide financing for the Kaburkaala copper exploration project to secure long-term supply for its smelting complex in Mundra, India. Codelco and Adani Group agreed to a partnership last year and evaluated various potential Codelco copper projects before selecting Kaburkaala. The agreement for the project was signed between Codelco and Kutch Copper Limited, which is a part of Adani Group.

stories.headline: Nifty closes 0.84% higher, cooling off from intraday highs
stories.text: The BSE Sensex gained 772.75 points or 0.95 per cent to settle at 81,879.40. Foreign institutional investors infused roughly ₹54,000 crore, equivalent to about $5.68 billion, in the first nine days of November. The yield of the benchmark 10-year G-Sec rose 6 basis points to close at 7.21 per cent. The US October Consumer Price Index rose 0.4 per cent month-on-month, exceeding the 0.3 per cent expectation.

stories.headline: Air India’s H1 FY27 loss reduces by around ₹2,000 crore, helps Singapore Airlines offset profit decline
stories.text: Singapore Airlines stated that a ₹2,000-odd crore reduction in Air India's loss helped offset some of its net profit decline in the first half of FY27 on Wednesday. The Singapore Airlines group reported that its first half net profit fell 44 per cent to SGD 134 million due to lower operating profit. Singapore Airlines' interim financial statements showed its share of losses in Air India in the first half of the current fiscal was SGD 361.7 million. Air India incurred a loss of ₹10,851 crore in the first half of FY27 compared to ₹12,885 crore in the same period last year.

stories.headline: Tata Power says Singapore shares pledged with banks, safe from immediate seizure
stories.text: Tata Power Company Ltd stated on Wednesday that the shares of its two Singapore-based subsidiaries pledged with banks are unlikely to be seized immediately. Tata Power managing director Praveer Sinha stated that the share-sale process could take between 3-6 months. Tata Power managing director Praveer Sinha stated that the company's appeal against the Singapore International Commercial Court order will be heard on 19 January. British Virgin Islands-based Kleros Capital stated that the unpaid arbitration award continues to accrue about $71,600 in interest each day.

stories.headline: Scotch imports: Finance, Commerce Ministries look for resolution as Diageo, Pernod shipments held up
stories.text: The Finance Ministry and Commerce Ministry are discussing a dispute regarding customs classification of bulk Scotch whisky imports from the UK involving Diageo and Pernod Ricard. Diageo and Pernod Ricard shipments are held up at Indian ports because of a disagreement over the applicable import duty. Customs investigators from the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence are seeking to levy a higher 150 per cent duty on the bulk Scotch whisky imports. Importers state the product falls under Chapter 22, Heading 2208 for spirits and whisky, while investigators examine if it belongs under Heading 2106 for food preparations.

stories.headline: Promoters, mutual funds hit record high as FII ownership hits 14-year low
stories.text: Foreign institutional investors' ownership of National Stock Exchange-listed companies fell to 15.57% as of September 30. Private promoters' combined holding in National Stock Exchange-listed companies rose to 41.93% in the September quarter. Mutual funds' ownership in National Stock Exchange-listed companies reached a fresh all-time high of 11.82% in the September quarter. Government promoter holding fell to 8.39% in the September quarter following net selling of Rs 38,260 crore.

stories.headline: Jacobs to develop 25-year master plan for Cochin International Airport in India – Company Announcement
stories.text: Jacobs was appointed by Cochin International Airport Limited to create a 25-year master plan for Cochin International Airport in Kerala, India. Jacobs Executive Vice President Sinead Giblin stated that the master plan will prepare the airport for future passenger and cargo demand. Cochin International Airport Limited Airport Director Manu G stated that the 25-year master plan is a significant milestone in shaping the company's long-term vision. Jacobs will lead the master planning from its operations in India with support from specialists based in the United Kingdom.

stories.headline: E-Rickshaws Lose Ground as L5 Electric Auto Sales Surge in India
stories.text: L5 electric autos surpassed e-rickshaws to become the larger segment in India's three-wheeler passenger market during Q2 FY27. L5 electric auto sales reached 1.28 lakh units in Q2 FY27. E-rickshaw sales stood at 93,000 units in Q2 FY27. E-carts continue to be the largest electric cargo category in India.

stories.headline: Japan’s FX Chief Warns Not To Forget Summer Intervention
stories.text: Japan's currency chief warned that it is too soon to forget the events of this summer after the yen weakened sharply. Japan's currency chief signaled that authorities stand ready to intervene again to support the Asian currency.

stories.headline: Your holiday credit-card bills are going up. What you can do to ease the pain.
stories.text: The government may have missed a month of inflation data as mentioned in the article text. Credit card annual percentage rates are not expected to decline due to the missing inflation data.

stories.headline: Falling oil prices are no longer enough to bring down borrowing costs in the world’s most important bond market
stories.text: The trading relationship between oil prices and Treasury yields has broken down according to the article. The breakdown of the trading relationship between oil prices and Treasury yields is described as a sign that inflation concerns are extending beyond the energy shock.

stories.headline: Arista Networks Stock Is AI Networking Demand Still Driving Strong Earnings
stories.text: Arista Networks reported strong third quarter results, though a significant portion stemmed from earlier deferred revenue reaching customer acceptance rather than solely new contracts. Arista Networks provided fourth quarter revenue guidance ranging from US$3.9b to US$4.0b. Simply Wall St Community investor DanielOliveira anchors the fair value of Arista Networks at US$169.91 to match the last close. Prior to the third quarter update, optimistic analysts estimated Arista Networks could reach revenue of approximately US$30.4b by 2029. Before the Q3 update, optimistic analysts estimated Arista Networks could achieve earnings of roughly US$11.6b by 2029.

stories.headline: With $720M round, Britain’s Fractile gets a leg up in the race for AI chips
stories.text: British artificial intelligence chip startup Fractile secured a $720 million Series C funding round supported by Britain’s Sovereign AI Fund. The funding round was led by Thrive Capital, Founders Fund, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Redpoint. The British government stated that Fractile achieved a valuation of over £5 billion following the funding round. Financial Times and a Reuters source reported that Fractile's valuation reached $7 billion. Fractile intends to utilize the new funding to ship its first chips and systems next year according to CEO Walter Goodwin.

stories.headline: Silicon Valley is 'a center for espionage,' former FBI agent warns after Nvidia spy scandal
stories.text: Nvidia announced an independent investigation by its board of directors on Sunday regarding an affair between CEO Jensen Huang and an alleged Chinese spy. Jensen Huang admitted to and apologized for the affair in a statement released on Sunday. At the time of the announcement, the Nvidia board stated it had no reason to believe national security or company secrets were compromised. Mark Trott, a former FBI special agent and Concentric Advisors program manager, stated that Silicon Valley is a center for espionage. China denied the spy plot allegations targeting Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, describing the accusations as a smear.

stories.headline: Germany’s E.ON Explores Former Nuclear Plant Sites For AI Data Centres
stories.text: German energy company E.ON is examining the repurposing of former nuclear power plant sites for data centres to meet rising electricity demand from Europe's artificial intelligence industry. E.ON Chief Financial Officer Nadia Jakobi discussed this possibility during the company's earnings presentation on November 11, 2026. The assessment is still at an early stage, with no final investment decision or construction timetable announced by E.ON. Germany completed the shutdown of its remaining operating nuclear power reactors in 2023. E.ON has not disclosed the number of retired nuclear sites being evaluated or the potential investment required for the projects.

stories.headline: Big Walk used AI to fix a bug. Now the indie gaming world is having a reckoning.
stories.text: Nineteen members of the Independent Games Festival Awards jury released a signed statement declining to vote for any game using generative AI. Developer House House admitted that large language models were used sparingly near the end of developing the game Big Walk to fix bugs. House House stated that the AI-assisted code represented well under 0.1 percent of Big Walk's total code. House House did not disclose the AI usage during the Steam release because Valve does not request disclosure of code or chatbot usage. Following the public disclosure, the Steam page for Big Walk received over 400 negative reviews from disappointed fans and observers.

stories.headline: Google’s Tabletop AI experiment lets you build custom collaboration apps
stories.text: Google introduced a new experimental artificial intelligence tool known as Tabletop to create customizable collaborative spaces for coordination among family and friends. Google Labs design and engineering lead Roman Nurik stated that users can add links, files, and ideas and prompt the system to generate custom interactive tools. Users can share an invite link in group chats to allow multiple people to access and use the space simultaneously. Availability for the Tabletop beta version is currently being distributed through a waitlist. Participation in the Tabletop beta is restricted to individuals in the United States who are over the age of 18.

stories.headline: From blood group ID to cycle racks: I asked for little ways to fix broken Britain and the public’s ideas give me hope | Martin Lewis
stories.text: Martin Lewis launched the Small Ideas Initiative a month ago as an apolitical national suggestion box to gather practical ways to improve the United Kingdom. The Small Ideas Initiative has already received 42,000 suggestions from the public since its launch. Martin Lewis funded the Small Ideas Initiative with charities Nesta and Involve running a project in the background. The project aims to filter suggestions, select and publish at least 1,000 of the best, and turn 200 into fully researched policy proposals. Members of the public have until 5pm on Thursday 12 November to submit their solutions at Small-Ideas.org.

stories.headline: AI datacentres plan on-site power stations on huge scale despite climate risks, research reveals
stories.text: Developers of artificial intelligence datacentres across the United States, the United Kingdom, and mainland Europe have proposed building on-site fossil fuel plants to create 181GW of gas-fired capacity due to national grid connection delays. Research from BloombergNEF indicates that this planned rollout of on-site gas-fired power stations will emit approximately 345 million metric tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent annually in the United States, where 90 percent of these stations are planned. Mark Daly, the head of datacentres and emerging tech at BloombergNEF, stated that extraordinary economics around artificial intelligence make speed to power a critical priority for developers. The report by BloombergNEF predicted that by 2035, the electricity demand of artificial intelligence datacentres will almost quadruple to 2,354 terawatt-hours, matching 7 percent of global electricity demand. UK locations such as Wapseys Wood in Buckinghamshire and Quest Park in Bedfordshire are seeking to construct their own on-site gas-fired power stations due to long grid connection waits.

stories.headline: Senators Ask Trump Administration to Preserve Nvidia Documents
stories.text: Two Democratic senators made a request to the Trump administration on Thursday concerning Nvidia Corp. records. The senators asked for the preservation of all records regarding the export of Nvidia Corp. advanced semiconductors. The records requested involve exports to China or to entities that might divert such chips.

stories.headline: Modi Ally Chandrababu Naidu Sees Google Project on Track, New Data Centers
stories.text: Alphabet Inc.’s Google AI hub in Andhra Pradesh is on track to begin operations in 2028, according to Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu. N. Chandrababu Naidu stated that the Alphabet Inc. project in Andhra Pradesh is valued at $15 billion. N. Chandrababu Naidu pledged to provide uninterrupted power and water supplies for the project despite local resource concerns.

stories.headline: Oil India among 6 stocks closing above VWAP
stories.text: On November 11, six Nifty 500 stocks closed more than 1.5% above their volume weighted average prices based on StockEdge technical scan data. Volume Weighted Average Price represents the average price at which a stock traded during the day, with higher weight given to prices with greater trading volumes. A closing price above the Volume Weighted Average Price indicates that a stock finished the session higher than its volume-weighted average traded price.

stories.headline: Houthi rebels’ fresh demands put Chinese firms in a dilemma, analyst warns
stories.text: Listed Hong Kong and mainland Chinese companies face a dilemma due to escalating conflicts between Saudi Arabia and Houthi rebels in Yemen. An analyst stated that the situation requires serious attention from businesses operating in the oil-rich region. The Humanitarian Operations Coordination Centre is a body set up by the Houthis in Yemen's capital, Sanaa, to protect facilities from future attacks.

stories.headline: Q2 Results, Nov 12: HAL, Vodafone Idea, Hitachi Energy, RVNL, IRCTC, Alkem Labs, Oil India, Page Industries, Bharat Dynamics, others to post earnings
stories.text: Page Industries, Bharat Dynamics, Indian Railway Catering & Tourism Corp, Manappuram Finance, and Ola Electric Mobility are among the companies scheduled to release their earnings on November 12, 2026. More than 400 companies will report their earnings for Q2 FY27 on Thursday, November 12, 2026. An unnamed company's revenue from operations increased by 26% to ₹19,636 crore in the September quarter compared to ₹15,545 crore in the corresponding period of the previous year.

stories.headline: Stock recommendations for 12 November from MarketSmith India
stories.text: Foreign institutional buying drove market gains with inflows reaching about ₹ 53,170 crore over six trading sessions in November. Nifty 50 companies reported nearly 24% profit growth in their September-quarter earnings, lifting market sentiment. MarketSmith India issued buy recommendations for Karnataka Bank Ltd at a current price of ₹ 350 and DCB Bank Ltd at ₹ 221.

stories.headline: Mexico says crackdown on Asian steel shipments is paying off as US tariff talks advance
stories.text: Luis Rosendo Gutierrez stated the Mexican government tightened traceability measures with industry to prevent products from reaching the United States by exploiting trade preferences. The cancellation of nonexistent mill registrations helped cut steel imports from Vietnam by 80% in some months. The reduction in steel and aluminum imports from third countries stemmed about 13 billion pesos, equivalent to $698.54 million, in imports.

stories.headline: EAAA India Alternatives Q2 results 2026: Net profit jumps 27%; 140% interim dividend of ₹7/share; check record date
stories.text: EAAA India Alternatives posted a 12.9% year-on-year rise in revenue from operations to ₹251.49 crore for the September quarter. EAAA India Alternatives announced an interim dividend of ₹7 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. EAAA India Alternatives fixed November 17, 2026, as the record date for the interim dividend.

stories.headline: Indices hold gains at noon; M&M, IndiGo top Nifty charts as IT stocks drag
stories.text: Mahindra & Mahindra led the Nifty 50 gainers by rising 4.38 per cent to ₹3,434.80. ICICI Bank was the heaviest loser by value on the Nifty, falling 1.24 per cent to ₹1,569.30. The Indian rupee traded around 93.85 against the US dollar, down 0.07 per cent on the day.

stories.headline: CAS strikes again: Nifty surges over 2% to 25,600 before closing at 25,250; Sensex sees a spike of 375...
stories.text: On November 11, the Nifty surged over 2% to 25,600 during the indicative close before closing at 25,250 due to sharp swings during the Closing Auction Session. stories.text: CoreWeave reported a strong quarter that signals firm sector demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure. stories.text: Alibaba noted it had confidentially filed on Sept. 11 to list T-Head on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, subject to approvals. stories.text: Cambodia and Thailand have been sending officials to Paris to consult maps from the French government archives due to border tensions and diplomatic and legal disputes. Sar Sokha has retained two law firms to prevent facing sanctions as Washington targets Chinese organised crime.

stories.headline: Iran’s chief negotiator tells Al Jazeera ‘ball in US court’
stories.text: Iran’s chief negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf stated in an exclusive interview that the United States needs to respond to Iran's position in the ongoing peace talks.
